title.zh: 卷296 列傳八十三 岳鍾琪 超龙 鍾璜 浚 策棱 成衮扎布 车布登扎布
title.en: Volume 296 Biographies 83: Yue Zhong Qi, Chao Long, Zhong Huang, Jun, Ce Leng, Cheng Gunzhabu, Che Bu Deng Zha Bu
title.raw: 卷296 列傳八十三 岳鍾琪 超龙 鍾璜 浚 策棱 成衮扎布 车布登扎布

sentences.zh: 列傳八十三

translations.literal: Biographies, number eighty-three.
translations.idiomatic: Biography 83

sentences.zh: 岳鍾琪季父超龍超龍子鍾璜鍾琪子濬策棱子成袞扎布車布登扎布

translations.literal: Yue Zhongqi; his father's younger brother Chao Long; Chao Long's son Zhong Huang; Zhongqi's son Jun; Celeng's son Chenggun Zhabu; Chebudeng Zhabu.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Zhongqi; his father's younger brother Chao Long; Chao Long's son Zhong Huang; Zhongqi's son Jun; Celeng's son Chenggun Zhabu; and Chebudeng Zhabu.

sentences.zh: 岳鍾琪，字東美，四川成都人。

translations.literal: Yue Zhongqi, style Dongmei, was a native of Chengdu in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Zhongqi, styled Dongmei, was a native of Chengdu in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 父昇龍，初入伍，授永泰營千總。

translations.literal: His father Shenglong, at first entered military service and was appointed battalion commander of the Yongtai Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shenglong had first entered military service and was appointed a company commander in the Yongtai Garrison.

sentences.zh: 康熙十二年，吳三桂反，永泰營游擊許忠臣受三桂劄。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Kangxi, Wu Sangui rebelled; the Yongtai Garrison colonel Xu Zhongchen received a commission from Sangui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of the Kangxi reign (1673), Wu Sangui rebelled, and Xu Zhongchen, colonel of the Yongtai Garrison, accepted a commission from him.

sentences.zh: 昇龍使詣提督張勇告變，密結兵民，執忠臣殺之。

translations.literal: Shenglong sent someone to the provincial commander Zhang Yong to report the treason, secretly rallied troops and civilians, seized Zhongchen and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Shenglong sent word to Provincial Commander Zhang Yong to report the plot, secretly rallied soldiers and civilians, seized Zhongchen, and put him to death.

sentences.zh: 十四年，從西寧總兵王進寶克蘭州，先登被創，遷莊浪守備；

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, he followed Xining regional commander Wang Jinbao in capturing Lanzhou, was first over the wall and wounded, and was transferred to garrison commandant of Zhuanglang;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year (1675), he followed Regional Commander Wang Jinbao of Xining in the capture of Lanzhou, was first over the wall and wounded in the assault, and was transferred to garrison commandant of Zhuanglang;

sentences.zh: 從克臨洮，平關隴，加都督僉事銜。

translations.literal: he followed in the capture of Lintao, pacified Guanlong, and was given the brevet rank of vice commissioner-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: he then took part in the capture of Lintao and the pacification of Guanlong, and was granted the brevet rank of vice commissioner-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 累擢天津總兵。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to regional commander of Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive promotions to regional commander of Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，昇龍將三百騎護糧。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year, the emperor personally campaigned against Galdan; Shenglong led three hundred cavalry to escort provisions.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year of Kangxi (1696), when the emperor led a personal campaign against Galdan, Shenglong commanded three hundred cavalry to escort the supply train.

sentences.zh: 上命昇龍及馬進良、白斌，副將以次有違令退怯者，得斬之乃聞。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Shenglong, Ma Jinliang, and Bai Bin that if any deputy commander or below disobeyed orders or showed cowardice in retreat, they might behead them and report afterward.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Shenglong, Ma Jinliang, and Bai Bin that if any officer of deputy commander rank or below disobeyed orders or retreated in cowardice, they were authorized to execute him on the spot and report afterward.

sentences.zh: 昭莫多之捷，授拖沙喇哈番，擢四川提督。

translations.literal: After the victory at Jao Modo, he was granted the title of tosahala han and promoted to provincial military commander of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: After the victory at Jao Modo, he was ennobled as tosahala han and promoted to provincial military commander of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 初，西藏營官入駐打箭爐，上使勘界。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Tibetan garrison officer had entered and garrisoned Dartsendo; the emperor sent men to survey the boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, a Tibetan garrison officer had been stationed at Dartsendo, and the emperor had sent officials to survey the border.

sentences.zh: 四川巡撫於養志言營官司貿易，不與地方事。

translations.literal: The Sichuan governor Yu Yangzhi said the garrison officer dealt only in trade and did not interfere in local affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Governor Yu Yangzhi reported that the garrison officer was engaged only in trade and did not meddle in local administration.

sentences.zh: 居數年，營官喋吧昌側集烈發兵據瀘河東諸堡，昇龍以五百人防化林營。

translations.literal: After several years, the garrison officer Diba Changce Jilie raised troops and seized the forts east of the Lu River; Shenglong defended the Hualin Garrison with five hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: Several years later, the garrison officer Diba Changce Jilie raised troops and seized the forts east of the Lu River, and Shenglong defended the Hualin Garrison with five hundred men.

sentences.zh: 養志反劾昇龍擅發兵，昇龍亦訐養志。

translations.literal: Yangzhi in turn impeached Shenglong for deploying troops on his own authority; Shenglong also accused Yangzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzhi in turn impeached Shenglong for deploying troops without authorization, while Shenglong lodged accusations against Yangzhi as well.

sentences.zh: 上使勘讞，養志坐斬，昇龍亦奪官。

translations.literal: The emperor sent men to investigate and judge the case; Yangzhi was sentenced to decapitation, and Shenglong was also stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent officials to investigate and adjudicate the case; Yangzhi was sentenced to execution, and Shenglong was also dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 喋吧昌側集烈擊殺明正土司蛇蠟喳吧，傷官兵，提督唐希順討之，上命昇龍從軍。

translations.literal: Diba Changce Jilie killed the Mingzheng tusi Shela Zhaba, wounded officers and soldiers; provincial commander Tang Xishun campaigned against him, and the emperor ordered Shenglong to join the army.
translations.idiomatic: Diba Changce Jilie killed Mingzheng Tusi Shela Zhaba and wounded government troops; Provincial Commander Tang Xishun marched against him, and the emperor ordered Shenglong to serve in the campaign.

sentences.zh: 事定，希順以病解任，仍授昇龍提督。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, Xishun resigned on grounds of illness, and Shenglong was again appointed provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign ended, Xishun resigned due to illness, and Shenglong was again appointed provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，乞休。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year, he requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year of Kangxi (1710), he requested retirement.

sentences.zh: 昇龍本貫甘肅臨洮，以母年逾九十，乞入籍四川，許之。

translations.literal: Shenglong was originally registered in Lintao, Gansu; because his mother was over ninety, he asked to be registered in Sichuan, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Shenglong was originally registered in Lintao, Gansu; because his mother was over ninety years old, he petitioned to be registered in Sichuan, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 逾二年，卒。

translations.literal: More than two years later, he died.
translations.idiomatic: A little more than two years later, he died.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年，追諡敏肅。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng, he was posthumously given the temple name Minsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Yongzheng reign (1726), he was posthumously honored with the temple name Minsu.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪，初入貲為同知。

translations.literal: Zhongqi, at first purchased office as subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi had first purchased office as a subprefect.

sentences.zh: 從軍，請改武職，上命以游擊發四川，旋授松潘鎮中軍游擊。

translations.literal: He joined the army, asked to transfer to a military post; the emperor ordered him dispatched to Sichuan as colonel, and soon appointed colonel of the central battalion at Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: He then entered military service and petitioned to transfer to a military post; the emperor ordered him sent to Sichuan as a colonel and soon appointed him colonel of the central battalion at Songpan.

sentences.zh: 再遷四川永寧協副將。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to deputy regional commander of the Yongning Brigade in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was subsequently promoted to deputy regional commander of the Yongning Brigade in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 五十八年，準噶爾策妄阿喇布坦遣其將策淩敦多卜襲西藏，都統法喇督兵出打箭爐，撫定里塘、巴塘。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year, the Dzungar Tsewang Arabtan sent his general Tsering Dondup to raid Tibet; the commandant Fala led troops out from Dartsendo and pacified Litang and Batang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-eighth year of Kangxi (1719), the Dzungar ruler Tsewang Arabtan sent his general Tsering Dondup to raid Tibet; Commandant Fala led troops out from Dartsendo and pacified Litang and Batang.

sentences.zh: 檄鍾琪前驅，至里塘，第巴不受命，誅之。

translations.literal: Zhongqi was ordered as vanguard; reaching Litang, the deba disobeyed orders and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi was ordered to advance as vanguard; when he reached Litang, the local ruler (deba) refused to obey orders and was executed.

sentences.zh: 巴塘第巴懼，獻戶籍。

translations.literal: The Batang deba was afraid and submitted household registers.
translations.idiomatic: The Batang deba, fearing the same fate, submitted his household registers.

sentences.zh: 乍丫、察木多、察哇諸番目皆順命。

translations.literal: The chieftains of Chaya, Chamdo, Chawa, and other tribes all submitted to orders.
translations.idiomatic: The chieftains of Chaya, Chamdo, Chawa, and other tribes all submitted to Qing authority.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，定西將軍噶爾弼師自拉里入，仍令鍾琪前驅。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year, Pacification General of Dingxi Garbi led his army in from Lhari, and again ordered Zhongqi as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year (1720), Pacification General Garbi of Dingxi led his army in from Lhari, and again appointed Zhongqi as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪次察木多，選軍中通西藏語者三十人，更衣間行至洛隆宗，斬準噶爾使人，番眾驚，請降。

translations.literal: Zhongqi halted at Chamdo, selected thirty soldiers who knew Tibetan, changed clothes and traveled by secret route to Lhorong Dzong, beheaded Dzungar envoys; the tribes were alarmed and asked to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi halted at Chamdo, selected thirty soldiers who spoke Tibetan, disguised themselves and traveled by a secret route to Lhorong Dzong, beheaded Dzungar envoys, and the local tribes, alarmed, petitioned to surrender.

sentences.zh: 噶爾弼至軍，用鍾琪策，招西藏公佈，以二千人出降。

translations.literal: When Garbi reached the army, he used Zhongqi's plan to summon the Tibetan regent, and two thousand men came out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: When Garbi reached the army, he adopted Zhongqi's plan to summon the Tibetan regent (gongbo), and two thousand men came out to surrender.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪遂督兵渡江，直薄拉薩，大破西藏兵，擒喇嘛為內應者四百餘人。

translations.literal: Zhongqi then supervised troops crossing the river, pressed straight on Lhasa, routed the Tibetan army greatly, and captured more than four hundred lamas who had served as inside collaborators.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi then led his troops across the river, pressed directly on Lhasa, routed the Tibetan forces, and captured more than four hundred lamas who had acted as collaborators within the city.

sentences.zh: 策淩敦多卜敗走，西藏平。

translations.literal: Tsering Dondup was defeated and fled; Tibet was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Tsering Dondup was defeated and fled, and Tibet was pacified.

sentences.zh: 六十年，師還，授左都督，擢四川提督，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year, the army returned; he was appointed left regional commander, promoted to Sichuan provincial commander, and granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year (1721), after the army returned, he was appointed left regional commander, promoted to provincial military commander of Sichuan, and granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 命討郭羅克番部，鍾琪率師並督瓦斯、雜穀諸土司兵自松潘出邊。

translations.literal: He was ordered to campaign against the Golog tribes; Zhongqi led the army and also directed the native troops of Was and Zagun chieftains out from Songpan beyond the border.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to campaign against the Golog tribes; Zhongqi led the army and also directed the native troops of the Was and Zagun chieftains out from Songpan beyond the frontier.

sentences.zh: 郭羅克番兵千餘出拒，鍾琪擊破之，取下郭羅克吉宜卡等二十一寨，殲其眾。

translations.literal: More than a thousand Golog tribesmen came out to resist; Zhongqi defeated them, took twenty-one stockades including Jiyika in Lower Golog, and annihilated their forces.
translations.idiomatic: More than a thousand Golog tribesmen came out to resist; Zhongqi defeated them, captured twenty-one stockades including Jiyika in Lower Golog, and annihilated their forces.

sentences.zh: 乘夜督兵進至中郭羅克納務寨，番兵出拒，鍾琪奮擊，未終日，連克十九寨，斬三百餘級，獲其渠駿他爾唪索布六戈。

translations.literal: Taking advantage of night he led troops to Nawu stockade in Middle Golog; tribesmen came out to resist, Zhongqi fought fiercely, and before the day ended had taken nineteen stockades in succession, beheaded more than three hundred, and captured their leader Juntai'er Baisuobuliuge.
translations.idiomatic: Under cover of night he advanced to Nawu stockade in Middle Golog; when tribesmen came out to resist, Zhongqi attacked fiercely and, before the day was out, had taken nineteen stockades in succession, killing more than three hundred men and capturing their leader Juntai'er Baisuobuliuge.

sentences.zh: 复督兵進攻上郭羅克押六寨，番目旦增縛首惡假磕等二十二人以降。

translations.literal: Again he supervised troops attacking the six stockades of Upper Golog; the chieftain Danzeng bound the ringleaders Jia Ke and twenty-one others and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: He then led troops against the six stockades of Upper Golog; the chieftain Danzeng bound the ringleaders Jia Ke and twenty-one others and surrendered them.

sentences.zh: 郭羅克三部悉定，予拜他喇布勒哈番世職。

translations.literal: All three divisions of Golog were completely pacified; he was granted the hereditary rank of baitalabule han.
translations.idiomatic: All three divisions of Golog were fully pacified, and he was granted the hereditary rank of baitalabule han.

sentences.zh: 六十一年，討平羊峒番，於其地設南坪營。

translations.literal: In the sixty-first year, he campaigned and pacified the Yangdong tribes, and established the Nanping Garrison in that region.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixty-first year (1722), he campaigned against and pacified the Yangdong tribes and established the Nanping Garrison in their territory.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，師討青海，撫遠大將軍年羹堯請以鍾琪參贊軍事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, the army campaigned against Qinghai; the Pacification Commissioner General Nian Gengyao asked that Zhongqi assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongzheng (1723), when the army campaigned against Qinghai, Pacification Commissioner General Nian Gengyao requested that Zhongqi serve as his military adviser.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪將六千人出歸德堡，撫定上寺東策卜、下寺東策卜諸番部。

translations.literal: Zhongqi led six thousand men out from Guide Fort and pacified the tribes of Upper Sidongcebu and Lower Sidongcebu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi led six thousand men out from Guide Fort and pacified the tribes of Upper and Lower Sidongcebu.

sentences.zh: 南川塞外郭密九部屢盜邊，而呈庫、活爾賈二部尤橫。

translations.literal: The nine Guomi tribes beyond the frontier at Nanchuan repeatedly raided the border, and the Chenku and Huo'erjia tribes were especially violent.
translations.idiomatic: The nine Guomi tribes beyond the Nanchuan frontier repeatedly raided the border, and the Chenku and Huo'erjia tribes were especially aggressive.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪移師深入搗其巢，盡平之。

translations.literal: Zhongqi moved his army deep in to strike their nests and completely pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi moved his army deep into their territory, struck at their strongholds, and completely pacified them.

sentences.zh: 二年，授奮威將軍，趣進兵。

translations.literal: In the second year, he was appointed Valiant Might General and urged to advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year (1724), he was appointed Valiant Might General and ordered to press the advance.

sentences.zh: 郭隆寺喇嘛應羅卜藏丹津為亂，鍾琪會諸軍合擊，殲其眾，毀寺，擒戮其渠達克瑪胡土克圖。

translations.literal: The lamas of Kumbum Monastery joined Lobzang Danjin in rebellion; Zhongqi joined the various armies in combined attack, annihilated their forces, destroyed the monastery, and captured and executed their leader Dakma Hutuktu.
translations.idiomatic: The lamas of Kumbum Monastery joined Lobzang Danjin in rebellion; Zhongqi coordinated the various armies in a combined assault, annihilated their forces, destroyed the monastery, and captured and executed their leader Dakma Hutuktu.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏丹津居額穆納布隆吉爾，其大酋阿爾布坦溫布、吹拉克諾木齊分屯諸隘，鍾琪與諸將分道入。

translations.literal: Lobzang Danjin dwelt at Emu Na Bulongji'er; his great chiefs Arbu Tanwenbu and Chuilake Nuomuqi garrisoned the various passes separately; Zhongqi and the generals entered by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Danjin was encamped at Emu Na Bulongji'er; his principal chiefs Arbu Tanwenbu and Chuilake Nuomuqi held the various passes; Zhongqi and the other generals advanced by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪及侍衛達鼐出南路，總兵武正安出北路，黃喜林、宋可進出中路，副將王嵩、紀成斌搜山。

translations.literal: Zhongqi and bodyguard Datan went out by the southern route; regional commander Wu Zheng'an by the northern route; Huang Xilin and Song Kejin by the central route; deputy generals Wang Song and Ji Chengbin searched the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi and Imperial Bodyguard Datan advanced by the southern route; Regional Commander Wu Zheng'an by the northern route; Huang Xilin and Song Kejin by the central route; and Deputy Generals Wang Song and Ji Chengbin searched the mountain country.

sentences.zh: 師進至哈喇烏蘇，方黎明，番眾未起，即縱擊，斬千餘人，番眾驚走，逐之，一晝夜至伊克喀爾吉，獲阿爾布坦溫布。

translations.literal: The army advanced to Halasu; just at dawn, before the tribesmen had risen, they attacked at once, beheaded more than a thousand; the tribes fled in alarm, were pursued, and in one day and night reached Yikeka'erji, capturing Arbu Tanwenbu.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced to Halasu; at dawn, before the tribesmen had risen, they attacked at once, killing more than a thousand; the tribes fled in alarm and were pursued; in one day and night they reached Yikeka'erji and captured Arbu Tanwenbu.

sentences.zh: 復進次席爾哈羅色，遣兵攻噶斯；

translations.literal: Advancing again they halted at Xi'erhaluose and dispatched troops to attack Gasi;
translations.idiomatic: They advanced again and halted at Xi'erhaluose, dispatching troops to attack Gasi;

sentences.zh: 復進次佈爾哈屯，薄額穆納布隆吉爾，羅卜藏丹津西竄，鍾琪逐之，一晝夜馳三百里。

translations.literal: advancing again they halted at Bu'erhatun, pressed on Emu Na Bulongji'er; Lobzang Danjin fled west; Zhongqi pursued him, riding three hundred li in one day and night.
translations.idiomatic: then advanced again to Bu'erhatun and pressed on Emu Na Bulongji'er; Lobzang Danjin fled westward, and Zhongqi pursued him, covering three hundred li in a single day and night.

sentences.zh: 其酋彭錯等來降，鍾琪令守備劉廷言監以前驅，鍾琪繼其後。

translations.literal: Their chiefs Pengcuo and others came to surrender; Zhongqi ordered garrison commandant Liu Tingyan to supervise as vanguard, with Zhongqi following behind.
translations.idiomatic: Their chiefs Pengcuo and others came to surrender; Zhongqi ordered Garrison Commandant Liu Tingyan to lead the vanguard while he followed behind.

sentences.zh: 其酋吹因來降，言羅卜藏丹津所在距師百五六十里。

translations.literal: Their chief Chuiyin came to surrender, saying Lobzang Danjin's position was one hundred fifty or sixty li from the army.
translations.idiomatic: Another chief, Chuiyin, came to surrender and reported that Lobzang Danjin was one hundred fifty or sixty li from the army.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪令暫休，薄暮復進，黎明至其地。

translations.literal: Zhongqi ordered a brief rest, then advanced again at dusk, and at dawn reached the place.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi ordered a brief halt, then resumed the march at dusk and reached the enemy position at dawn.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏丹津之眾方散就水草，即縱擊，大破之，擒諸台吉，並羅卜藏丹津母阿爾泰哈屯及女弟阿寶，羅卜藏丹津易婦人服以遁。

translations.literal: Lobzang Danjin's forces had just scattered to graze by water and grass; they attacked at once and routed them greatly, capturing the various taiji, together with Lobzang Danjin's mother Altai Hatun and younger sister Abao; Lobzang Danjin changed into women's dress and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Danjin's followers had just scattered to graze their herds; Zhongqi attacked at once and routed them decisively, capturing the various taiji as well as Lobzang Danjin's mother Altai Hatun and younger sister Abao; Lobzang Danjin himself escaped disguised in women's clothing.

sentences.zh: 廷言等亦得吹拉克諾木齊等。

translations.literal: Tingyan and others also captured Chuilake Nuomuqi and others.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Tingyan and the others also captured Chuilake Nuomuqi and his followers.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪復進至桑駝海，不見虜​​乃還。

translations.literal: Zhongqi advanced again to Sangtuohai; seeing no enemy, he returned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi advanced again to Sangtuohai; finding no enemy there, he withdrew.

sentences.zh: 出師十五日，斬八萬餘級。

translations.literal: In fifteen days of campaigning, more than eighty thousand were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: In fifteen days of campaigning, more than eighty thousand enemy dead were reported.

sentences.zh: 大酋助羅卜藏丹津為亂者皆就擒。

translations.literal: The great chiefs who had aided Lobzang Danjin in rebellion were all captured.
translations.idiomatic: All the principal chiefs who had aided Lobzang Danjin in the rebellion were captured.

sentences.zh: 青海平，上授鍾琪三等公，賜黃帶。

translations.literal: Qinghai was pacified; the emperor granted Zhongqi the rank of third-class duke and bestowed the yellow belt.
translations.idiomatic: With Qinghai pacified, the emperor granted Zhongqi the rank of third-class duke and bestowed the yellow belt upon him.

sentences.zh: 莊浪邊外謝爾蘇部土番據桌子、棋子二山為亂，納硃公寺、朝天堂、加爾多寺諸番與相糾合。

translations.literal: Beyond the Zhuanglang frontier, the Xie'ersu tribal chieftains occupied Tables Mountain and Chess Pieces Mountain in rebellion; the tribes of Nazhu Gongsi, Chaotiantang, and Jia'erduo joined with them.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the Zhuanglang frontier, the Xie'ersu tribal chieftains rose in rebellion, occupying Tables Mountain and Chess Pieces Mountain, and were joined by the tribes affiliated with Nazhu Gongsi, Chaotiantang, and Jia'erduo monasteries.

sentences.zh: 羹堯遣鍾琪等督兵分十一路進剿，凡五十餘日，悉討平之。

translations.literal: Gengyao dispatched Zhongqi and others to supervise troops advancing in eleven columns to suppress them; in more than fifty days all were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Nian Gengyao dispatched Zhongqi and others to lead troops in eleven columns against them; within fifty-odd days all were pacified.

sentences.zh: 命兼甘肅提督。

translations.literal: He was ordered to serve concurrently as Gansu provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to serve concurrently as provincial military commander of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 三年，復命兼甘肅巡撫。

translations.literal: In the third year, he was again ordered to serve concurrently as Gansu governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1725), he was again ordered to serve concurrently as governor of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 四月，解羹堯兵柄，改授杭州將軍，命鍾琪亦上奮威將軍印，署川陝總督，盡護諸軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Gengyao was relieved of military authority, transferred to Hangzhou general; Zhongqi was also ordered to surrender the Valiant Might General seal, and was made acting governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi, protecting all armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Nian Gengyao was stripped of military command and reassigned as general of Hangzhou; Zhongqi was ordered to surrender the Valiant Might General seal, appointed acting governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi, and placed in command of all armies.

sentences.zh: 河州、​​松潘舊為青海蒙古互市地，羹堯奏移於那喇薩喇。

translations.literal: Hezhou and Songpan had formerly been the places where Qinghai Mongols traded; Gengyao memorialized to move the market to Nalasala.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhou and Songpan had long been the sites of trade fairs with the Qinghai Mongols; Nian Gengyao had memorialized to move the fairs to Nalasala.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪奏言青海部長察罕丹津等部落居黃河東，請仍於河州、松潘互市。

translations.literal: Zhongqi memorialized that the Qinghai tribal leaders Chahan Danjin and others dwelt east of the Yellow River, and asked that trade still be conducted at Hezhou and Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi memorialized that the Qinghai tribal leaders Chahan Danjin and others lived east of the Yellow River and requested that trade continue at Hezhou and Songpan.

sentences.zh: 額爾德尼額爾克托克托鼐等部落居黃河西，請移市西寧塞外丹噶爾寺。

translations.literal: The tribes of Erdeni Erke Tokto and others dwelt west of the Yellow River; he asked to move the market outside Xining at Danggar Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes of Erdeni Erke Tokto and others lived west of the Yellow River; he asked that their market be moved to Danggar Monastery outside Xining.

sentences.zh: 蒙古生業，全資牲畜，請六月後不時交易。

translations.literal: The Mongols' livelihood depended entirely on livestock; he asked that after the sixth month trade be permitted at irregular times.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Mongols depended entirely on livestock for their livelihood, he requested that trade be permitted outside the regular season after the sixth month.

sentences.zh: 四川雜穀、金川、沃日諸土司爭界，羹堯令金川割美同等寨畀沃日，致仇殺不已。

translations.literal: The native chieftains of Zagun, Jinchuan, and Wori in Sichuan disputed boundaries; Gengyao ordered Jinchuan to cede stockades such as Meitong to Wori, causing unending blood feuds.
translations.idiomatic: The native chieftains of Zagun, Jinchuan, and Wori in Sichuan were disputing boundaries; Nian Gengyao had ordered Jinchuan to cede stockades such as Meitong to Wori, which led to unending blood feuds.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪奏請還金川，而以龍堡三歌地予沃日，上皆許之。

translations.literal: Zhongqi memorialized to return the territory to Jinchuan and give Wori the three districts of Longbao, and the emperor approved all.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi memorialized to restore the territory to Jinchuan and instead grant Wori the three districts of Longbao, and the emperor approved all his requests.

sentences.zh: 尋真除川陝總督。

translations.literal: Soon he was formally appointed governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon formally appointed governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「土司承襲，文武吏往往索費，封其印數年不與，致番目專恣仇殺。

translations.literal: He memorialized: 'When native chieftains succeeded to office, civil and military officials often demanded fees, kept their seals sealed for years without granting them, causing tribal officers to act arbitrarily in vendetta killings.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "When native chieftains succeeded to office, civil and military officials often demanded bribes and withheld their seals for years without granting formal investiture, causing tribal officers to act with impunity in blood feuds.

sentences.zh: 請定限半年，仍令應襲者先行署理。

translations.literal: He asked to fix a limit of half a year, and still to let the heir presumptive administer affairs provisionally in advance.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that a limit of half a year be fixed and that the designated heir be allowed to administer affairs provisionally in the meantime.

sentences.zh: 土司有外支循謹能治事者，許土官詳督撫給職銜，分轄其地，多三之一，少五之一，使勢相維、情相安。」

translations.literal: Where a native chieftain had collateral branches that were prudent and able to govern affairs, the chieftain might report in detail to the governor-general to grant titles and divide jurisdiction over the territory, at most one-third and at least one-fifth, so that power would check power and feelings would be at peace.'
translations.idiomatic: Where a native chieftain had collateral branches that were prudent and capable, he proposed that the chieftain report to the governor-general to grant them titles and divide jurisdiction over the territory—allocating at most one-third and at least one-fifth—so that power would balance power and factions would remain at peace."

sentences.zh: 入覲，加兵部尚書銜。

translations.literal: When he attended audience at court, he was given the brevet rank of minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: When he attended audience at court, he was granted the brevet rank of minister of war.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「察木多外魯隆宗察哇、坐爾剛、桑噶、吹宗、袞卓諸部，距打箭爐遠，不便遙制。

translations.literal: He memorialized: 'Beyond Chamdo, the districts of Lhorong Dzong, Chawa, Zuo'ergang, Sangga, Chuizong, and Gunzhuo are far from Dartsendo and inconvenient to control from afar.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Beyond Chamdo, the districts of Lhorong Dzong, Chawa, Zuo'ergang, Sangga, Chuizong, and Gunzhuo lie far from Dartsendo and are difficult to govern from a distance.

sentences.zh: 請宣諭達賴喇嘛，令轄其地。

translations.literal: He asked to proclaim instructions to the Dalai Lama to have him govern those lands.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that instructions be sent to the Dalai Lama to place those districts under his jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 中甸、里塘、巴塘及得爾格特、瓦舒霍耳諸地，並歸內地土司。」

translations.literal: Zhongdian, Litang, Batang, and the lands of De'erge and Washuhuo'er should all be returned to interior native chieftains.'
translations.idiomatic: Zhongdian, Litang, Batang, and the territories of De'erge and Washuhuo'er should all be placed under interior native chieftains."

sentences.zh: 又言：「巴塘隸四川，中甸隸雲南，而巴塘所屬木咱爾、祁宗、拉普、維西諸地偪近中甸，總會於阿墩子，實中甸門戶。

translations.literal: He also said: 'Batang is subordinate to Sichuan and Zhongdian to Yunnan, but the districts under Batang—Muzha'er, Qizong, Lapu, Weixi—press close to Zhongdian; all converge at Adunzi, which is in fact the gateway to Zhongdian.
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed: "Batang is subordinate to Sichuan and Zhongdian to Yunnan, yet the districts under Batang—Muzha'er, Qizong, Lapu, and Weixi—lie close to Zhongdian; all converge at Adunzi, which is in effect the gateway to Zhongdian.

sentences.zh: 請改隸雲南，與四川里塘、打箭爐互為犄角。」

translations.literal: He asked to change their affiliation to Yunnan, so that with Sichuan's Litang and Dartsendo they would mutually form pincers.'
translations.idiomatic: He asked that they be transferred to Yunnan so that, together with Litang and Dartsendo in Sichuan, they would form a mutually supporting strategic triangle."

sentences.zh: 下王大臣議，如所請。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the princes and ministers for deliberation, and was granted as requested.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the princes and ministers for deliberation, and his requests were approved.

sentences.zh: 四年春，請選西安滿洲兵千人駐潼關。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, he asked to select one thousand Manchu troops from Xi'an to garrison Tongguan.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year (1726), he requested that one thousand Manchu troops from Xi'an be stationed at Tongguan.

sentences.zh: 冬，請以陝、甘兩省丁銀攤入地畝徵收，自雍正五年始，著為定例。

translations.literal: In winter, he asked that the poll-tax silver of Shaanxi and Gansu provinces be assessed into land tax and collected per mu, beginning from the fifth year of Yongzheng, and established as a fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, he proposed that the poll-tax silver of Shaanxi and Gansu be merged into the land tax and collected per mu of land, beginning in the fifth year of Yongzheng, as a permanent regulation.

sentences.zh: 逾年，复疏言甘屬河東糧輕丁多，河西糧多丁少，請將二屬各自均派：河東丁隨糧辦，河西糧照丁攤。

translations.literal: The following year, he again memorialized that east of the river in Gansu grain was light and households many, while west of the river grain was heavy and households few; he asked that the two regions each be assessed separately: east of the river poll tax following grain, west of the river grain following poll tax.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, he memorialized again that in Gansu east of the river land tax was light but households numerous, while west of the river land tax was heavy but households few; he asked that each region be assessed separately—east of the river assigning poll tax by grain quota, west of the river assigning land tax by household count.

sentences.zh: 下部議行。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the ministry for deliberation and carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was referred to the relevant ministry for deliberation and approved for implementation.

sentences.zh: 四川烏蒙土知府祿萬鍾擾雲南東川，鎮雄土知府隴慶侯及建昌屬冕山、涼山諸苗助為亂。

translations.literal: In Sichuan, the native prefect of Wumeng Lu Wanzhong harassed Dongchuan in Yunnan; the native prefect of Zhenxiong Long Qinghou and the Miao of Mianshan and Liangshan under Jianchang aided the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In Sichuan, Wumeng Native Prefect Lu Wanzhong harassed Dongchuan in Yunnan; Zhenxiong Native Prefect Long Qinghou and the Miao of Mianshan and Liangshan under Jianchang joined in the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 上命鍾琪與雲貴總督鄂爾泰會師討之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Zhongqi and Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general Ortai to join forces and campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Zhongqi and Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Ortai to join forces and suppress the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 五年春，擒萬鍾，慶侯亦降。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year, Wanzhong was captured and Qinghou also surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year (1727), Wanzhong was captured and Qinghou also surrendered.

sentences.zh: 烏蒙、鎮雄皆改土歸流。

translations.literal: Wumeng and Zhenxiong were both converted from native rule to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng and Zhenxiong were both converted from native chieftain rule to direct imperial administration.

sentences.zh: 冕山、涼山亦以次底定。

translations.literal: Mianshan and Liangshan were also pacified in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Mianshan and Liangshan were likewise pacified in succession.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪督三省天下勁兵處，疑忌眾。

translations.literal: Zhongqi governed three provinces where the empire's strongest troops were stationed; suspicion of him was widespread.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi governed three provinces that held the empire's finest troops, and he aroused widespread suspicion.

sentences.zh: 成都訛言鍾琪將反，鍾琪疏聞，上諭曰：「數年以來，讒鍾琪者不止謗書一篋，甚且謂鍾琪為岳飛裔，欲報宋、金之仇。

translations.literal: In Chengdu a rumor spread that Zhongqi would rebel; Zhongqi memorialized to report it; the emperor instructed: 'For several years, those who slandered Zhongqi filled more than a basket of libelous writings, even saying Zhongqi was a descendant of Yue Fei who wished to avenge the Song-Jin enmity.
translations.idiomatic: A rumor spread in Chengdu that Zhongqi was about to rebel; Zhongqi reported it in a memorial, and the emperor instructed: "For several years, slander against Zhongqi has filled more than a basket of libelous writings; some have even claimed that Zhongqi is a descendant of Yue Fei who wishes to avenge the old Song-Jin enmity.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪懋著勳勞，朕故任以要地，付之重兵。

translations.literal: Zhongqi has shown outstanding merit; I therefore appoint him to a key post and entrust him with heavy forces.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi has rendered outstanding service, and that is why I appoint him to a key post and entrust him with heavy forces.

sentences.zh: 川、陝軍民，受聖祖六十餘年厚澤，尊君親上，眾共聞知。

translations.literal: The soldiers and people of Sichuan and Shaanxi have received the late emperor's generous favor for more than sixty years; reverence for the ruler and loyalty to superiors are known to all.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers and people of Sichuan and Shaanxi have enjoyed the late emperor's generous favor for more than sixty years; their loyalty to the throne is known to all.

sentences.zh: 今此造言之人，不但謗大臣，並誣川、陝軍民以大逆。

translations.literal: Now these rumor-mongers not only slander a great minister but also falsely charge the soldiers and people of Sichuan and Shaanxi with great treason.
translations.idiomatic: Those who spread these rumors slander not only a great minister but also falsely charge the soldiers and people of Sichuan and Shaanxi with treason.

sentences.zh: 命巡撫黃炳、提督黃廷桂嚴鞫。」

translations.literal: Order Governors Huang Bing and Provincial Commander Huang Tinggui to investigate strictly.'
translations.idiomatic: I order Governor Huang Bing and Provincial Commander Huang Tinggui to investigate the matter rigorously."

sentences.zh: 尋奏湖廣人盧宗寄居四川，因私事造蜚語，無主使者，論斬。

translations.literal: Soon it was reported that Lu Zong of Huguang, residing in Sichuan, had spread slander over a private matter; there was no principal instigator; he was sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward it was reported that Lu Zong of Huguang, while residing in Sichuan, had spread slander over a private grievance; no principal instigator was found, and he was sentenced to execution.

sentences.zh: 六年，疏請以建昌屬河西、寧番兩土司及阿都、阿史、紐結、歪溪諸地改土歸流，河東宣慰司以其地之半改隸流官，升建昌為府，領三縣，並釐定營汛職制，及善後諸事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he memorialized to convert from native rule to regular administration the two native chieftains of Hexi and Ningfan under Jianchang, and the districts of Adu, Ashi, Niujie, and Waixi; the pacification commissioner east of the river was to have half his territory transferred to regular officials; Jianchang was to be elevated to a prefecture governing three counties; and garrison posts, official ranks, and various matters of post-pacification settlement were to be arranged.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1728), he memorialized to convert the Hexi and Ningfan native chieftains under Jianchang and the districts of Adu, Ashi, Niujie, and Waixi from native to regular administration; to transfer half the territory of the pacification commissioner east of the river to regular officials; to elevate Jianchang to a prefecture governing three counties; and to establish garrison posts, official ranks, and other post-pacification arrangements.

sentences.zh: 下部議，如所請。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the ministry for deliberation and granted as requested.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was referred to the relevant ministry and approved as requested.

sentences.zh: 定新設府曰寧遠，縣曰西昌、冕寧、鹽源，又請改岷州兩土司歸流。

translations.literal: The new prefecture was named Ningyuan, with counties Xichang, Mianning, and Yanyuan; he also asked to convert the two native chieftains of Minzhou to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: The new prefecture was named Ningyuan, with the counties Xichang, Mianning, and Yanyuan; he also requested the conversion of the two Minzhou native chieftains to regular administration.

sentences.zh: 尋分疏請升四川達州，陝西秦、階二縣為直隸州。

translations.literal: Soon he submitted separate memorials asking to elevate Dazhou in Sichuan and Qin and Jie counties in Shaanxi to directly administered prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He soon submitted separate memorials requesting the elevation of Dazhou in Sichuan and the counties of Qin and Jie in Shaanxi to directly administered prefectures.

sentences.zh: 七年，又分疏請升甘肅肅州為直隸州，陝西子午谷隘口增防守官兵，里塘、巴塘諸地，置宣撫、安撫諸司至千百戶，視流官例題補。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he again submitted separate memorials asking to elevate Suzhou in Gansu to a directly administered prefecture, to increase garrison troops at the Ziwu Valley pass in Shaanxi, and to establish pacification and consolation offices and offices down to the thousand-household level at Litang, Batang, and other places, with appointments following the regular official pattern.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1729), he memorialized again to elevate Suzhou in Gansu to a directly administered prefecture, increase defensive troops at the Ziwu Valley pass in Shaanxi, and establish pacification and consolation offices and subordinate offices down to the thousand-household level at Litang, Batang, and elsewhere, with appointments following regular official procedures.

sentences.zh: 俱議行。

translations.literal: All were deliberated upon and carried out.
translations.idiomatic: All proposals were deliberated upon and approved for implementation.

sentences.zh: 雷波土司為亂，遣兵討平之。

translations.literal: The Leibo native chieftain rebelled; troops were dispatched and the rebellion was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: When the Leibo native chieftain rebelled, troops were dispatched and the uprising was suppressed.

sentences.zh: 靖州諸生曾靜遣其徒張熙投書鍾琪，勸使反。

translations.literal: Zeng Jing, a licentiate of Jingzhou, sent his disciple Zhang Xi to deliver a letter to Zhongqi urging him to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Jing, a licentiate of Jingzhou, sent his disciple Zhang Xi to deliver a letter to Zhongqi urging him to rise in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪與設誓，具得靜始末，疏聞。

translations.literal: Zhongqi swore an oath with him, obtained the full account from the beginning with Jing, and memorialized to report it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi took an oath with Zhang Xi, obtained the full account of Zeng Jing's plot from beginning to end, and reported it in a memorial.

sentences.zh: 上褒鍾琪忠，遣侍郎杭奕祿等至湖南逮鞫治，語詳杭奕祿傳。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Zhongqi's loyalty and dispatched Vice Minister Hang Yilu and others to Hunan to arrest and try the case; details are given in Hang Yilu's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Zhongqi's loyalty and dispatched Vice Minister Hang Yilu and others to Hunan to arrest and try the conspirators; the full account appears in Hang Yilu's biography.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏丹津之敗也，走投準噶爾，其酋策妄阿喇布坦納之。

translations.literal: When Lobzang Danjin was defeated, he fled for refuge to the Dzungars, and their chief Tsewang Arabtan received him.
translations.idiomatic: After Lobzang Danjin's defeat, he fled to the Dzungars for refuge, and their ruler Tsewang Arabtan received him.

sentences.zh: 策妄阿喇布坦死，子噶爾丹策零立，數侵掠喀爾喀諸部。

translations.literal: Tsewang Arabtan died and his son Galdan Tsering succeeded; he repeatedly raided the Khalkha tribes.
translations.idiomatic: When Tsewang Arabtan died, his son Galdan Tsering succeeded him and repeatedly raided the Khalkha tribes.

sentences.zh: 上命傅爾丹為靖邊大將軍，屯阿爾泰山，出北路；

translations.literal: The emperor appointed Furdan Pacification Commissioner General of the Border, garrisoned at the Altai Mountains, to advance by the northern route;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor appointed Furdan Pacification Commissioner General of the Border, stationed at the Altai Mountains, to advance by the northern route;

sentences.zh: 鍾琪為寧遠大將軍，屯巴里坤，出西路：討之。

translations.literal: Zhongqi was appointed Pacification Commissioner General of Ningyuan, garrisoned at Barkol, to advance by the western route, to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi was appointed Pacification Commissioner General of Ningyuan, stationed at Barkol, to advance by the western route against the Dzungars.

sentences.zh: 加鍾琪少保，以四川提督紀成斌等參贊軍務。

translations.literal: Zhongqi was given the rank of Junior Guardian; Sichuan Provincial Commander Ji Chengbin and others assisted in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi was promoted to Junior Guardian, with Sichuan Provincial Commander Ji Chengbin and others serving as military advisers.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪率師至巴里坤，築東西二城備儲胥，簡卒伍為深入計。

translations.literal: Zhongqi led his army to Barkol, built eastern and western walled cities to store provisions, and selected troops for a plan of deep advance.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi led his army to Barkol, built eastern and western walled cities for supply storage, and selected elite troops for a planned deep advance.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，召鍾琪及傅爾丹詣京師授方略，鍾琪請以成斌護大將軍印。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year, Zhongqi and Furdan were summoned to the capital to receive strategy; Zhongqi asked that Chengbin guard the great general's seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year (1730), Zhongqi and Furdan were summoned to the capital to receive strategic instructions; Zhongqi asked that Chengbin be left to guard the great general's seal.

sentences.zh: 科舍圖嶺者，界巴密、巴里坤間，鍾琪設牧廠於此。

translations.literal: Keshetu Ridge lies between Bami and Barkol; Zhongqi established a pasture there.
translations.idiomatic: Keshetu Ridge lies between Bami and Barkol, and Zhongqi established a pasture depot there.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾聞鍾琪方入覲，乘間以二萬餘人入犯，盡驅駝馬去。

translations.literal: The Dzungars heard that Zhongqi had entered the capital for audience and seized the opportunity to invade with more than twenty thousand men, driving off all the camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that Zhongqi had gone to the capital for audience, the Dzungars seized the opportunity to invade with more than twenty thousand men and drove off all the camels and horses at the pasture.

sentences.zh: 成斌使副參領查廩以萬人護牧廠，寇至不能禦，走過總兵曹勷壘呼救；

translations.literal: Chengbi sent Deputy Commander-in-chief Zha Lin with ten thousand men to guard the pasture; when the enemy arrived they could not resist, fled, and passed Regional Commander Cao Xiang's camp calling for help;
translations.idiomatic: Chengbi sent Deputy Commander-in-chief Zha Lin with ten thousand men to guard the pasture; when the enemy arrived they could not hold and fled past Regional Commander Cao Xiang's camp calling for help;

sentences.zh: 勷以輕騎往赴，戰敗亦走。

translations.literal: Xiang went with light cavalry to their aid, was defeated in battle, and also fled.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang rode out with light cavalry to their aid, was defeated, and also fled.

sentences.zh: 總兵樊廷及副將冶大雄等將二千人，轉戰七晝夜。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Fan Ting and Deputy General Ye Daxiong and others with two thousand men fought on for seven days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Fan Ting and Deputy General Ye Daxiong and others, with two thousand men, fought on for seven days and nights.

sentences.zh: 總兵張元佐督所部夾擊，拔出兩卡倫官兵，還所掠駝馬強半。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Zhang Yuanzuo directed his troops in a pincer attack, rescued the officers and soldiers of two outposts, and recovered more than half the camels and horses that had been seized.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Zhang Yuanzuo directed his troops in a pincer attack, rescued the officers and soldiers of two outposts, and recovered more than half the seized camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 成斌欲罪查廩，既而釋之，以捷聞。

translations.literal: Chengbi wished to punish Zha Lin, but then released him and reported a victory.
translations.idiomatic: Chengbi wished to punish Zha Lin but then released him and reported a victory.

sentences.zh: 上已遣鍾琪還鎮，上謂當於卡倫外築城駐兵，出遊兵擊敵，俾不敢深入，令鍾琪詳議。

translations.literal: The emperor had already sent Zhongqi back to his command; he said that beyond the outposts walled cities should be built with garrison troops stationed, and mobile detachments sent out to strike the enemy so they would not dare penetrate deeply, and ordered Zhongqi to deliberate in detail.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had already sent Zhongqi back to his command and instructed that walled cities be built beyond the outposts with garrison troops, and mobile detachments sent out to strike the enemy so they would not dare penetrate deeply; he ordered Zhongqi to submit a detailed plan.

sentences.zh: 尋諭獎廷、大雄、元佐功，賜金予世職，遣內務府總管鄂善齎銀十萬犒師。

translations.literal: Soon he issued instructions commending the merit of Ting, Daxiong, and Yuanzuo, bestowing gold and hereditary offices; he dispatched Palace Steward E Shan with one hundred thousand taels of silver to reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: He soon issued instructions commending Fan Ting, Ye Daxiong, and Zhang Yuanzuo, bestowing gold and hereditary offices upon them, and dispatched Palace Steward E Shan with one hundred thousand taels of silver to reward the army.

sentences.zh: 立祠安西，祀陣亡將士。

translations.literal: A temple was established at Anxi to sacrifice to the officers and soldiers who died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: A temple was established at Anxi to honor the officers and soldiers who fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 上以酒三爵遙酹，亦俾鄂善齎往設祭。

translations.literal: The emperor offered three cups of wine from afar in libation, and also had E Shan carry them there to perform the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor offered three cups of wine in libation from afar and also had E Shan carry them to perform the sacrifice on site.

sentences.zh: 九年春，鍾琪請移兵駐吐魯番、巴爾庫爾，為深入計。

translations.literal: In the spring of the ninth year, Zhongqi asked to move troops to garrison Turfan and Barkul as part of the plan for deep advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the ninth year (1731), Zhongqi requested that troops be moved to garrison Turfan and Barkul as part of the plan for a deep advance.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「鍾琪前既輕言長驅直入，又為敵盜駝馬，既恥且憤，必欲進剿，直搗巢穴，能必勝乎？」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: 'Zhongqi earlier spoke lightly of a long drive straight in, and again let the enemy steal camels and horses; shamed and angry, he must wish to advance and campaign, striking straight at their nest—can he be sure of victory?'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "Zhongqi earlier spoke rashly of driving straight in, and then let the enemy steal our camels and horses; shamed and angry, he must wish to advance and strike at their nest—can he be sure of victory?"

sentences.zh: 九年正月，鍾琪部兵有自敵中脫歸者，言噶爾丹策零將移駐哈喇沙爾，以大隊赴西路，而令其將小策零敦多卜犯北路。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, soldiers of Zhongqi's army who had escaped from the enemy reported that Galdan Tsering was about to move his headquarters to Karashahr and lead a large force against the western route, while ordering his general Tsering Dondup to attack the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year, soldiers of Zhongqi's army who had escaped from the enemy reported that Galdan Tsering intended to move his headquarters to Karashahr and lead a large force against the western route, while ordering his general Tsering Dondup to attack the northern route.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪以聞，並言敵將自吐魯番侵哈密，擾安西、肅州邊界。

translations.literal: Zhongqi reported this and also said the enemy would invade Hami from Turfan and harass the borders of Anxi and Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi reported this and also stated that the enemy would invade Hami from Turfan and harass the borders of Anxi and Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 我軍眾寡莫敵，當持重堅壁固守，告北路遣兵應援，並調兵自無克克嶺三面夾擊。

translations.literal: Our forces were too few to match the enemy; he should hold firm behind strong walls, inform the northern route to send reinforcements, and also dispatch troops from Wukkek Ridge to attack from three sides.
translations.idiomatic: He argued that Qing forces were too few to match the enemy and proposed holding firm behind strong walls, requesting reinforcements from the northern route, and dispatching troops from Wukkek Ridge for a three-sided attack.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「前以鍾琪軍寡，諭令持重堅守，今已有二萬九千人。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: 'Earlier, because Zhongqi's army was few, I instructed him to hold firm and defend; now he already has twenty-nine thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "Earlier, because Zhongqi's army was small, I told him to hold firm and defend; now he already has twenty-nine thousand men.

sentences.zh: 樊廷馬步二千，敵彼二萬，轉戰七晝夜，猶足相當。

translations.literal: Fan Ting with two thousand horse and foot faced twenty thousand of the enemy and fought for seven days and nights, yet was fully their match.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Ting with two thousand horse and foot faced twenty thousand enemy and fought for seven days and nights, yet held his own.

sentences.zh: 乃以二萬九千人而云眾寡莫敵，何懦怯至此？

translations.literal: Yet with twenty-nine thousand men he says he cannot match the enemy in numbers—how can cowardice go so far?
translations.idiomatic: Yet with twenty-nine thousand men he claims he cannot match the enemy—how can cowardice go so far?

sentences.zh: 且前欲直搗伊犁，豈有賊至數百里內轉堅壁而不出乎？

translations.literal: And earlier he wished to strike straight at Yili—when the enemy comes within several hundred li, can he then hold behind walls and not come out?
translations.idiomatic: And earlier he wished to strike straight at Yili—when the enemy comes within several hundred li, will he then hold behind walls and refuse to come out?

sentences.zh: 賊果至巴爾庫爾，即敗逃，亦從科舍圖直走伊爾布爾和邵而遁。

translations.literal: If the enemy truly reaches Barkul, they will be defeated and flee, also fleeing straight from Keshetu toward Yierbu'erheshao.
translations.idiomatic: If the enemy truly reaches Barkul, they will be defeated and flee, retreating straight from Keshetu toward Yierbu'erheshao.

sentences.zh: 無克克嶺相去二三百里，安所得夾擊？

translations.literal: Wukkek Ridge is two or three hundred li away—how can there be a pincer attack?
translations.idiomatic: Wukkek Ridge is two or three hundred li away—how can there be a pincer attack?

sentences.zh: 鍾琪於地勢軍機，茫然不知，朕實為煩憂。」

translations.literal: Zhongqi is utterly ignorant of terrain and military affairs; I am truly troubled on his account.'
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi is utterly ignorant of terrain and military affairs; I am truly troubled on his account."

sentences.zh: 三月，準噶爾二千餘犯吐魯番，成斌遣廷將四千人​​赴援，敵引退。

translations.literal: In the third month, more than two thousand Dzungars invaded Turfan; Chengbi dispatched Ting with four thousand men to aid them, and the enemy withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, more than two thousand Dzungars invaded Turfan; Chengbi dispatched Fan Ting with four thousand men to relieve the city, and the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 四月，又以千餘人犯吐魯番，別以二百餘人犯陶賴卡倫。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, more than a thousand again invaded Turfan, while another two hundred-odd attacked the Taolai outpost.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, more than a thousand again invaded Turfan, while another two hundred-odd attacked the Taolai outpost.

sentences.zh: 六月，又以二千餘人圍魯谷慶城。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, more than two thousand again besieged Luguqing city.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, more than two thousand besieged Luguqing city.

sentences.zh: 吐魯番回目額敏和卓等率所部奮擊，殺二百餘人。

translations.literal: The Turfan Muslim chieftain Emin Hezhuo and others led their followers in a fierce attack and killed more than two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: The Turfan Muslim leader Emin Hezhuo and others led their followers in a fierce counterattack and killed more than two hundred.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪議令元佐、勷及張存孝將三千人赴援。

translations.literal: Zhongqi proposed that Yuanzuo, Xiang, and Zhang Cunxiao lead three thousand men to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi proposed that Yuanzuo, Xiang, and Zhang Cunxiao lead three thousand men to relieve the siege.

sentences.zh: 提督顏清如將二千人屯塔庫，成斌將四千人防陶賴，俟我軍進擊烏魯木齊，移回民入內地。

translations.literal: Provincial Commander Yan Qingru was to lead two thousand men to garrison Taku; Chengbi four thousand to defend Taolai; when our army advanced to strike Urumqi, the Muslim population was to be moved inland.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial Commander Yan Qingru would lead two thousand men to garrison Taku; Chengbi four thousand to defend Taolai; and when the army advanced to strike Urumqi, the Muslim population would be moved inland.

sentences.zh: 上諭鍾琪：「今年秋間襲擊，是第一善策。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed Zhongqi: 'A surprise attack this autumn is the best strategy.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed Zhongqi: "A surprise attack this autumn is the best strategy.

sentences.zh: 援吐魯番，乃不得已之舉。

translations.literal: Relieving Turfan is only a measure taken when there is no alternative.
translations.idiomatic: Relieving Turfan is only a measure taken when there is no alternative.

sentences.zh: 若但籌畫應援，而不計及襲擊，是捨本而逐末也。」

translations.literal: If he only plans for relief and does not consider surprise attack, he abandons the root and pursues the branch.'
translations.idiomatic: If he only plans for relief and does not consider a surprise attack, he abandons the root and pursues the branch."

sentences.zh: 魯谷慶城圍四十餘日不下，準噶爾移攻哈喇火州城，以梯登，回民擊殺三百餘人。

translations.literal: The siege of Luguqing city lasted more than forty days without success; the Dzungars shifted to attack Harahuozhou city, scaling the walls with ladders; the Muslims struck and killed more than three hundred.
translations.idiomatic: The siege of Luguqing city lasted more than forty days without success; the Dzungars then shifted to attack Harahuozhou, scaling the walls with ladders, and the defenders killed more than three hundred.

sentences.zh: 元佐等兵將至，敵引退。

translations.literal: When Yuanzuo's troops were about to arrive, the enemy withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuanzuo's troops were about to arrive, the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 七月，準噶爾大舉犯北路，傅爾丹之師大敗於和通腦兒，鍾琪請乘虛襲擊烏魯木齊。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Dzungars launched a major invasion of the northern route; Furdan's army was heavily defeated at Huitongnao'er; Zhongqi asked to take advantage of the opening to strike Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the Dzungars launched a major invasion of the northern route; Furdan's army suffered a crushing defeat at Huitongnao'er; Zhongqi asked to exploit the opening to strike Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 上諭鍾琪：「賊既得志於北路，今冬仍往西路，且增添賊眾，更多於侵犯北路，俱未可知。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed Zhongqi: 'The enemy having gained their objective on the northern route, this winter they may still go to the western route, and the enemy forces may be greater than those that invaded the northern route—all is uncertain.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed Zhongqi: "The enemy having gained their objective on the northern route, they may still strike the western route this winter, perhaps with even larger forces than those that invaded the north—all is uncertain.

sentences.zh: 當先事圖維，臨時權變，勿貪功前進，勿坐失機宜。」

translations.literal: He should plan ahead and act flexibly when the moment comes; he must not advance greedily for merit, nor sit by and miss the opportunity.'
translations.idiomatic: He must plan ahead and act flexibly when the moment comes; he must not advance greedily for merit, nor sit by and miss the opportunity."

sentences.zh: 並令略行襲擊，即撤兵回營。

translations.literal: He was also ordered to make a brief surprise attack and then withdraw the army to camp.
translations.idiomatic: He was also ordered to make a brief surprise attack and then withdraw to camp.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪自巴爾庫爾經伊爾布爾和邵至阿察河，遇敵，擊敗之。

translations.literal: Zhongqi advanced from Barkul via Yierbu'erheshao to the Acha River, encountered the enemy, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi advanced from Barkul via Yierbu'erheshao to the Acha River, encountered the enemy, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 逐至厄爾穆河，敵踞山梁以距。

translations.literal: Pursuing to the Er'mu River, the enemy held a mountain ridge to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing to the Er'mu River, the enemy held a mountain ridge to block his advance.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪令元佐將步兵為右翼，成斌將馬兵為左翼，勷及總兵王緒級自中路上山，參將黃正信率精銳自北山攻敵後，諸軍奮進，奪所踞山梁，敵敗走。

translations.literal: Zhongqi ordered Yuanzuo to lead infantry on the right wing, Chengbi cavalry on the left, Xiang and Regional Commander Wang Xuji up the central path, and Colonel Huang Zhengxin with elite troops to attack the enemy rear from the northern mountain; all armies pressed forward, seized the ridge, and the enemy fled in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi ordered Yuanzuo to lead infantry on the right wing, Chengbi cavalry on the left, Xiang and Regional Commander Wang Xuji up the central path, and Colonel Huang Zhengxin with elite troops to attack from the northern mountain; all columns pressed forward, seized the ridge, and the enemy fled in defeat.

sentences.zh: 諜言烏魯木齊敵帳盡徙，乃引兵還。

translations.literal: Spies reported that the enemy camps at Urumqi had all moved; he then led the army back.
translations.idiomatic: Intelligence reported that the enemy camps at Urumqi had all been abandoned; he then led the army back.

sentences.zh: 疏聞，上獎鍾琪進退遲速俱合機宜。

translations.literal: Reporting in a memorial, the emperor commended Zhongqi for advancing and retreating in accord with the occasion.
translations.idiomatic: In his memorial reporting the campaign, the emperor commended Zhongqi for advancing and retreating in accord with the occasion.

sentences.zh: 十二月，上追舉科舍圖之役，責成斌怠忽，降沙州副將。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the emperor reviewed the Keshetu campaign and blamed Chengbi for negligence, demoting him to deputy general of Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, reviewing the Keshetu campaign, the emperor blamed Chengbi for negligence and demoted him to deputy general of Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，鏡兒泉邏卒遇敵，殺其二，掠其一以去。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year, patrol soldiers at Jing'er Spring encountered the enemy, killed two, and one was seized and carried off.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year (1732), patrol soldiers at Jing'er Spring encountered the enemy, killed two of them, and one Qing soldier was seized and carried off.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪劾副將馬順，上並以鍾琪下部察議。

translations.literal: Zhongqi impeached Deputy General Ma Shun; the emperor also referred Zhongqi himself to the ministry for investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi impeached Deputy General Ma Shun; the emperor also referred Zhongqi himself to the ministry for investigation.

sentences.zh: 俄，準噶爾三千餘人犯哈密，鍾琪令勷、成斌將五千人自回落兔大坂，總兵紀豹將二千人自科舍圖嶺，分道赴援。

translations.literal: Soon more than three thousand Dzungars invaded Hami; Zhongqi ordered Xiang and Chengbi with five thousand men via Huiluotu Daban and Regional Commander Ji Bao with two thousand via Keshetu Ridge to relieve the city by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Soon more than three thousand Dzungars invaded Hami; Zhongqi ordered Xiang and Chengbi with five thousand men via Huiluotu Pass and Regional Commander Ji Bao with two thousand via Keshetu Ridge to relieve the city by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 又令副將軍石雲倬、常賚，鎮安將軍卓鼐分地設伏，待敵佔天生圈山口，顏清如屯塔爾那沁，遣參將米彪、副將陳經綸分道禦戰，敵引去。

translations.literal: He also ordered Deputy Generals Shi Yunzhuo and Chang Gai and Pacification General Zhuo Nai to set ambushes in assigned areas; when the enemy occupied Tianshengquan Pass, Yan Qingru garrisoned Ta'ernaqin; he dispatched Colonel Mi Biao and Deputy General Chen Jinglun by separate routes to fight; the enemy withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered Deputy Generals Shi Yunzhuo and Chang Gai and Pacification General Zhuo Nai to set ambushes; when the enemy occupied Tianshengquan Pass, Yan Qingru garrisoned Ta'ernaqin; he dispatched Colonel Mi Biao and Deputy General Chen Jinglun by separate routes to engage them, and the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 勷等將至二堡，遇準噶爾五千餘人，即縱兵奮戰一晝夜。

translations.literal: When Xiang and the others reached Erbao, they encountered more than five thousand Dzungars and attacked fiercely for one day and night.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiang and the others reached Erbao, they encountered more than five thousand Dzungars and fought fiercely for a full day and night.

sentences.zh: 敵登山，勷督兵圍山，力戰至午，敵潰遁。

translations.literal: The enemy climbed the mountain; Xiang supervised troops surrounding the mountain and fought until noon; the enemy broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy climbed the mountain; Xiang surrounded the heights and fought until noon, when the enemy broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 勷自二堡至柳拊泉，與經綸及副將焦景竑軍會，乘夜追剿。

translations.literal: From Erbao to Liufu Spring, Xiang joined Jinglun and Deputy General Jiao Jinghong's army and pursued through the night.
translations.idiomatic: From Erbao to Liufu Spring, Xiang joined Chen Jinglun and Deputy General Jiao Jinghong and pursued through the night.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪使告雲倬等，遣兵至無克克嶺待敵，疏聞，上獎慰之。

translations.literal: Zhongqi sent word to Yunzhuo and others to dispatch troops to Wukkek Ridge to await the enemy; reporting in a memorial, the emperor sent words of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi sent word to Yunzhuo and others to dispatch troops to Wukkek Ridge to intercept the enemy; in his memorial reporting these events, the emperor sent words of commendation.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪議城穆壘駐軍，並命乘勝興工。

translations.literal: Zhongqi proposed building a walled city at Mulei for a garrison and ordered construction to begin while victory was still fresh.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi proposed building a walled city at Mulei for a garrison and ordered construction to begin while the victory was still fresh.

sentences.zh: 雲倬等至無克克嶺，鍾琪令速赴梯子泉阻敵歸路，卓鼐繼其後。

translations.literal: When Yunzhuo and the others reached Wukkek Ridge, Zhongqi ordered them to hurry to Tiziquan to block the enemy's line of retreat, with Zhuo Nai following behind.
translations.idiomatic: When Yunzhuo and the others reached Wukkek Ridge, Zhongqi ordered them to hurry to Tiziquan to block the enemy's line of retreat, with Zhuo Nai following behind.

sentences.zh: 雲倬遲發一日，敵自陶賴大坂西越向納庫山遁去。

translations.literal: Yunzhuo was one day late in setting out; the enemy fled west over Taolai Daban toward Nakushan.
translations.idiomatic: Yunzhuo was one day late in setting out; the enemy fled west over Taolai Pass toward Nakushan.

sentences.zh: 師至敵駐軍處，餘火猶未息，雲倬又令毋追襲。

translations.literal: When the army reached where the enemy had camped, embers were still glowing; Yunzhuo again ordered that there be no pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached the enemy's former camp, embers were still glowing; Yunzhuo again ordered that there be no pursuit.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪劾雲倬僨事，奪官，逮京師治罪，以張廣泗代為副將軍。

translations.literal: Zhongqi impeached Yunzhuo for bungling affairs, stripped him of office, and had him arrested and sent to the capital for punishment; Zhang Guangsi was appointed deputy general in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi impeached Yunzhuo for bungling the operation, stripped him of office, and had him sent to the capital for punishment; Zhang Guangsi was appointed deputy general in his place.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「岳鍾琪素諳軍旅，本非庸才，但以懷游移之見，致戰守乖宜。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: 'Yue Zhongqi has long been versed in military affairs and is no ordinary man, but because he harbors wavering views, his conduct of war and defense has been inappropriate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "Yue Zhongqi has long been versed in military affairs and is no ordinary man, but because he harbors wavering views, his conduct of war and defense has been inappropriate.

sentences.zh: 前車之鑑，非止一端。

translations.literal: The lessons of past failures are not limited to a single instance.
translations.idiomatic: The lessons of past failures are not limited to a single instance.

sentences.zh: 嗣後當痛自省惕，壹號令，示威信，朕猶深望之！」

translations.literal: Hereafter he must deeply examine himself and be vigilant, unify his commands, and display authority and good faith—I still place high hopes in him!'
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter he must deeply examine himself, unify his commands, and display authority and good faith—I still place high hopes in him!"

sentences.zh: 大學士鄂爾泰等劾鍾琪專制邊疆，智不能料敵，勇不能殲敵。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Ortai and others impeached Zhongqi for acting arbitrarily on the frontier, lacking the wisdom to anticipate the enemy and the courage to annihilate them.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Ortai and others impeached Zhongqi for acting arbitrarily on the frontier, lacking the wisdom to anticipate the enemy and the courage to destroy them.

sentences.zh: 降三等侯，削少保，仍留總督銜，護大將軍印。

translations.literal: He was demoted to third-class marquis, stripped of Junior Guardian, but retained the governor-general title and continued to guard the great general's seal.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to third-class marquis, stripped of Junior Guardian, but retained the governor-general title and continued to guard the great general's seal.

sentences.zh: 六月，鍾琪疏報移軍穆壘。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Zhongqi memorialized reporting the transfer of troops to Mulei.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Zhongqi memorialized reporting the transfer of troops to Mulei.

sentences.zh: 尋召鍾琪還京師，以廣泗護印。

translations.literal: Soon Zhongqi was summoned back to the capital; Guangsi guarded the seal in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Zhongqi was summoned back to the capital, and Guangsi was left to guard the seal in his place.

sentences.zh: 廣泗劾鍾琪調兵籌餉、統馭將士，種種失宜。

translations.literal: Guangsi impeached Zhongqi for various improprieties in mobilizing troops, provisioning supplies, and commanding officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Guangsi impeached Zhongqi for various improprieties in mobilizing troops, provisioning supplies, and commanding officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 穆壘形如釜底，不可駐軍。

translations.literal: Mulei is shaped like the bottom of a cauldron and is unsuitable for garrisoning troops.
translations.idiomatic: Mulei is shaped like the bottom of a cauldron and unsuitable for garrisoning troops.

sentences.zh: 議分​​駐科舍圖、烏蘭烏蘇諸地。

translations.literal: It was proposed to divide garrisons among Keshetu, Wulanwusu, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: It was proposed to divide the garrison among Keshetu, Wulanwusu, and other places.

sentences.zh: 上命還軍巴爾庫爾，盡奪鍾琪官爵，交兵部拘禁。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the army withdrawn to Barkul, stripped Zhongqi of all offices and ranks, and handed him over to the Board of War for detention.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the army withdrawn to Barkul, stripped Zhongqi of all offices and ranks, and handed him over to the Board of War for detention.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以查郎阿署大將軍，又論鍾琪驕蹇不法，且劾成斌、元佐疏防，上命斬成斌，元佐降調。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Chalang'a was made acting great general; again Zhongqi was charged with arrogance and lawlessness, and Chengbi and Yuanzuo were also impeached for lax defense; the emperor ordered Chengbi beheaded and Yuanzuo demoted and transferred.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1733), Chalang'a was appointed acting great general; Zhongqi was again charged with arrogance and lawlessness, and Chengbi and Yuanzuo were impeached for lax defense; the emperor ordered Chengbi beheaded and Yuanzuo demoted and transferred.

sentences.zh: 又劾勷縱賊，上命斬勷。

translations.literal: Xiang was also impeached for letting the enemy escape; the emperor ordered Xiang beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Xiang was also impeached for letting the enemy escape; the emperor ordered him beheaded.

sentences.zh: 十二年，大學士等奏擬鍾琪斬決，上改監候。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, the grand secretaries memorialized proposing decapitation for Zhongqi; the emperor changed the sentence to imprisonment awaiting execution.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, the grand secretaries memorialized proposing decapitation for Zhongqi; the emperor commuted the sentence to imprisonment awaiting execution.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，釋歸。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong, he was released and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qianlong (1737), he was released and allowed to return home.

sentences.zh: 十三年，師徵大金川，久無功。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, the army campaigned against Greater Jinchuan for a long time without success.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1748), the army campaigned against Greater Jinchuan for a long time without success.

sentences.zh: 三月，高宗命起鍾琪，予總兵銜。

translations.literal: In the third month, the Gaozong Emperor ordered Zhongqi reinstated and granted him the rank of regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Gaozong Emperor ordered Zhongqi reinstated and granted him the rank of regional commander.

sentences.zh: 至軍，即授四川提督，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: When he reached the army, he was at once appointed Sichuan provincial commander and granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching the army, he was immediately appointed provincial military commander of Sichuan and granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 時經略大學士訥親視師，而廣泗以四川總督主軍事。

translations.literal: At that time Grand Secretary and Commissioner Neqin supervised the army on campaign, while Guangsi as Sichuan governor directed military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Grand Secretary and Commissioner Neqin supervised the campaign in person, while Guangsi as governor of Sichuan directed military affairs.

sentences.zh: 大金川酋莎羅奔居勒烏圍，其兄子郎卡居噶拉依。

translations.literal: The Greater Jinchuan chieftain Salopan held Lewu stockade, and his nephew Langka held Galai.
translations.idiomatic: The Greater Jinchuan chieftain Salopan held Lewu stockade, and his nephew Langka held Galai.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪至軍，訥親令攻黨壩。

translations.literal: When Zhongqi reached the army, Neqin ordered an attack on Dangba.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhongqi reached the army, Neqin ordered an attack on Dangba.

sentences.zh: 上以軍事諮鍾琪，鍾琪疏言：「黨壩為大金川門戶，碉卡嚴密，漢、土官兵止七千餘。

translations.literal: The emperor consulted Zhongqi on military affairs; Zhongqi memorialized: 'Dangba is the gateway to Greater Jinchuan; its blockhouses and outposts are strongly fortified; Han and native troops number only a little more than seven thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor consulted Zhongqi on military affairs; Zhongqi memorialized: "Dangba is the gateway to Greater Jinchuan; its blockhouses and outposts are strongly fortified; Han and native troops number only a little more than seven thousand.

sentences.zh: 臣商諸廣泗，請益兵三千，廣泗不應。

translations.literal: I discussed with Guangsi and asked for three thousand more troops; Guangsi did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: I discussed the matter with Guangsi and asked for three thousand additional troops, but Guangsi refused.

sentences.zh: 廣泗專主自昔嶺、卡撒進攻。

translations.literal: Guangsi insisted on advancing from Zixiling and Kasa.
translations.idiomatic: Guangsi insisted on advancing from Zixiling and Kasa.

sentences.zh: 此二處中隔噶拉依，距勒烏圍尚百餘裡。

translations.literal: These two places are separated by Galai, and are still more than a hundred li from Lewu stockade.
translations.idiomatic: These two routes are separated by Galai and lie still more than a hundred li from Lewu stockade.

sentences.zh: 黨壩至勒烏圍僅五六十里，若破康八達，即直搗其巢。

translations.literal: From Dangba to Lewu stockade is only fifty or sixty li; if Kangbada is taken, one can strike straight at their nest.
translations.idiomatic: From Dangba to Lewu stockade is only fifty or sixty li; once Kangbada falls, the army can strike straight at the enemy stronghold.

sentences.zh: 臣商諸廣泗，廣泗不謂然，而廣泗信用土舍良爾吉及漢奸王秋等，恐生他虞。」

translations.literal: I discussed with Guangsi; Guangsi did not agree, yet Guangsi trusted the native officer Liang'erji and the Han traitor Wang Qiu and others, which I feared might give rise to other troubles.'
translations.idiomatic: I discussed the plan with Guangsi, but he disagreed; moreover, he placed his trust in the native officer Liang'erji and the Han collaborator Wang Qiu, which I feared might lead to further complications."

sentences.zh: 訥親亦劾廣泗老師糜餉，詔逮治；

translations.literal: Neqin also impeached Guangsi for keeping the army idle and wasting provisions; an edict ordered his arrest and trial;
translations.idiomatic: Neqin also impeached Guangsi for keeping the army idle and wasting provisions; an edict ordered his arrest and trial;

sentences.zh: 亦罷訥親​​大學士，傅恆代為經略。

translations.literal: Neqin was also dismissed from his grand secretary post, and Fu Heng replaced him as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Neqin was also dismissed from his post as grand secretary, and Fu Heng was appointed commissioner in his place.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪奏請選精兵三萬五千，萬人出黨壩及瀘河，水陸並進；

translations.literal: Zhongqi memorialized requesting the selection of thirty-five thousand elite troops: ten thousand to advance from Dangba and the Lu River by land and water together;
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi memorialized requesting thirty-five thousand picked troops: ten thousand to advance from Dangba and the Lu River by land and water in concert;

sentences.zh: 萬人自甲索攻馬牙岡、乃當兩溝，與黨壩軍合，直攻勒烏圍；

translations.literal: ten thousand from Jiasuo to attack Mayagang and Naidang Lianggou, unite with the Dangba army, and strike directly at Lewu stockade;
translations.idiomatic: ten thousand from Jiasuo to attack Mayagang and Naidang Lianggou, join the Dangba column, and strike straight at Lewu stockade;

sentences.zh: 卡撒留兵八千，俟克勒烏圍，前後夾攻噶拉依；

translations.literal: eight thousand to remain at Kasa; once Lewu stockade was taken, attack Galai from front and rear;
translations.idiomatic: eight thousand to remain at Kasa and, once Lewu stockade fell, attack Galai from front and rear;

sentences.zh: 黨壩留兵二千護糧，正地留兵千防瀘河，餘四千往來策應。

translations.literal: two thousand at Dangba to guard grain, one thousand at Zhengdi to defend the Lu River, the remaining four thousand to move back and forth in support.
translations.idiomatic: two thousand at Dangba to guard supplies, one thousand at Zhengdi to hold the Lu River, and the remaining four thousand to shuttle in support.

sentences.zh: 期一年擒莎羅奔及郎卡。

translations.literal: He set a term of one year to capture Salopan and Langka.
translations.idiomatic: He pledged to capture Salopan and Langka within one year.

sentences.zh: 臣雖老，請肩斯任。」

translations.literal: "Though I am old, I beg to shoulder this responsibility."
translations.idiomatic: "Though I am old, I beg to shoulder this charge."

sentences.zh: 命傅恆籌議，傅恆用其策。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Fu Heng to deliberate, and Fu Heng adopted his plan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Fu Heng to deliberate the plan, and Fu Heng adopted it.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪自黨壩攻康八達山梁，大破賊。

translations.literal: Zhongqi attacked from Dangba against the Kangbada ridge and inflicted a great defeat on the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi attacked from Dangba against the Kangbada ridge and routed the rebels.

sentences.zh: 師進戰塔高山梁，复屢破賊。

translations.literal: The army advanced and fought at the Tagao ridge, repeatedly defeating the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced to the Tagao ridge and again and again defeated the enemy.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪初佐年羹堯定西藏，莎羅奔以土目從軍；

translations.literal: Zhongqi had earlier assisted Nian Gengyao in pacifying Tibet; Salopan had followed the army as a native officer;
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi had earlier assisted Nian Gengyao in pacifying Tibet; Salopan had served in the campaign as a native officer;

sentences.zh: 及為總督，以羹堯所割金川屬寨還莎羅奔，且奏給印信、號紙，莎羅奔以是德鍾琪。

translations.literal: when he became governor-general, he restored to Salopan the Jinchuan dependent stockades that Nian Gengyao had carved away, and moreover memorialized granting him official seals and certificates of appointment; Salopan was therefore indebted to Zhongqi.
translations.idiomatic: when he became governor-general, he restored to Salopan the Jinchuan dependent stockades that Nian Gengyao had taken away, memorialized for official seals and appointment papers, and Salopan was therefore indebted to Zhongqi.

sentences.zh: 師入，莎羅奔懼，遣使詣鍾琪乞降。

translations.literal: When the army entered, Salopan, fearing, sent envoys to Zhongqi to beg surrender.
