translations.idiomatic: When the army entered Jinchuan, Salopan, in fear, sent envoys to Zhongqi to sue for surrender.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪請於傅恆，以十三騎從入勒烏圍開諭。

translations.literal: Zhongqi asked Fu Heng's permission and, with thirteen horsemen as escort, entered Lewu stockade to expound and persuade.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi asked Fu Heng's leave and, with only thirteen horsemen in attendance, entered Lewu stockade to persuade them.

sentences.zh: 莎羅奔請奉約束，頂經立誓，次日，率郎卡從鍾琪乘皮船出詣軍前降。

translations.literal: Salopan requested to submit to discipline, swore an oath upon the sutras, and the next day led Langka with Zhongqi aboard a leather boat to appear before the army and surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Salopan pledged to submit to discipline, swore upon the scriptures, and the next day led Langka with Zhongqi in a hide boat to surrender before the army.

sentences.zh: 上諭獎鍾琪，加太子少保，复封三等公，賜號曰威信。

translations.literal: The emperor issued an edict praising Zhongqi, promoted him to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, restored his third-rank duke title, and granted him the honorific name Weixin.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Zhongqi in an edict, promoted him to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, restored his third-rank duke title, and granted him the honorific name Weixin ("Prestigious Trust").

sentences.zh: 入覲，命紫禁城騎馬，免西征追償銀七十餘萬，官其子沺、淓侍衛，賜詩褒之。

translations.literal: On audience in the capital, he was permitted to ride a horse within the Forbidden City, was exempted from repaying more than seven hundred thousand taels owed from the western expedition, and his sons Tuan and Fang were appointed as imperial bodyguards; the emperor bestowed a commendatory poem.
translations.idiomatic: On audience at court he was permitted to ride within the Forbidden City, was exempted from repaying more than seven hundred thousand taels from the western expedition, and his sons Tuan and Fang were made imperial bodyguards; the emperor bestowed a poem in praise.

sentences.zh: 尋命還鎮。

translations.literal: Soon after he was ordered back to his post.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered back to his command.

sentences.zh: 十五年，西藏珠爾默特為亂，鍾琪出駐打箭爐，事旋定。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Zurmiddorji of Tibet rose in rebellion; Zhongqi marched out and garrisoned Dartsendo, and the affair was soon settled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1750), when Zurmiddorji of Tibet rebelled, Zhongqi marched out to garrison Dartsendo, and the affair was soon settled.

sentences.zh: 十七年，雜穀土司蒼旺為亂，鍾琪遣兵討擒之。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, the Zagu native official Cangwang rose in rebellion; Zhongqi sent troops to suppress and capture him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year (1752), when the Zagu native official Cangwang rebelled, Zhongqi sent troops to capture him.

sentences.zh: 十九年，重慶民陳琨為亂，鍾琪力疾親往捕治，還，卒於資州，賜祭葬，諡襄勤。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, the Chongqing commoner Chen Kun rebelled; Zhongqi, though gravely ill, went in person to capture and punish him; on his return he died at Zizhou; imperial sacrificial rites were granted, and he was given the posthumous name Xiangqin.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year (1754), when the Chongqing commoner Chen Kun rebelled, Zhongqi, though gravely ill, went in person to suppress him; on his return he died at Zizhou; imperial funeral rites were granted, and he was posthumously named Xiangqin ("Assisting and Diligent").

sentences.zh: 上以所封公爵不世襲，予一等輕車都尉，令其子瀞襲。

translations.literal: Because the duke title conferred upon him was not hereditary in perpetuity, the emperor granted the first-rank insignia of Qingche duwei and had his son Jing inherit it.
translations.idiomatic: Because the ducal title he had held was not perpetually hereditary, the emperor granted the first-rank Qingche duwei and had his son Jing inherit it.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪沈毅多智略，禦士卒嚴，而與同甘苦，人樂為用。

translations.literal: Zhongqi was deep, resolute, and full of stratagems; though strict toward his troops, he shared their hardships, and men were glad to serve him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi was grave, resolute, and resourceful; though stern with his troops, he shared their hardships, and men were glad to follow him.

sentences.zh: 世宗屢獎其忠誠，遂命專徵。

translations.literal: The Yongzheng Emperor repeatedly praised his loyalty and accordingly entrusted him with sole command of campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzheng Emperor repeatedly praised his loyalty and entrusted him with sole command of campaigns.

sentences.zh: 終清世，漢大臣拜大將軍，滿洲士卒隸麾下受節制，鍾琪一人而已。

translations.literal: Throughout the Qing dynasty, among Han ministers invested as grand general with Manchu soldiers under their command and subject to their direction, Zhongqi stood alone.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the Qing, among Han ministers made grand general with Manchu troops under their command, Zhongqi stood alone.

sentences.zh: 既廢復起，大金川之役，傅恆倚以成功。

translations.literal: Though dismissed and later recalled, in the Greater Jinchuan campaign Fu Heng relied on him for success.
translations.idiomatic: Though dismissed and later recalled, in the Greater Jinchuan campaign Fu Heng relied on him to win.

sentences.zh: 高宗御製懷舊詩，列五功臣中，稱為「三朝武臣巨擘」雲。

translations.literal: The Gaozong Emperor's own nostalgic poem, ranking him among five great merit officials, calls him "the foremost military minister across three reigns."
translations.idiomatic: In the Gaozong Emperor's own nostalgic poem ranking five great merit officials, he is called "the foremost military minister across three reigns."

sentences.zh: 超龍，昇龍弟，初冒劉姓，名曰傑。

translations.literal: Chao Long was Shenglong's younger brother; he originally bore the surname Liu and was called Jie.
translations.idiomatic: Chao Long was Shenglong's younger brother; he had first taken the surname Liu and the name Jie.

sentences.zh: 入伍，屢遷建昌左營守備。

translations.literal: He entered military service and rose through repeated promotions to garrison commandant of the Left Battalion at Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: He entered military service and rose to garrison commandant of the Left Battalion at Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 引見，聖祖垂詢，乃復本姓名，超擢東川營游擊。

translations.literal: On imperial audience, the Kangxi Emperor questioned him personally; he then restored his original surname and given name and was abruptly promoted to brigade vice-commander of the Dongchuan Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On audience the Kangxi Emperor questioned him in person; he then restored his original surname and name and was abruptly promoted to brigade vice-commander of the Dongchuan Garrison.

sentences.zh: 以避鍾琪，改西寧左營。

translations.literal: To avoid Zhongqi, he was transferred to the Left Battalion at Xining.
translations.idiomatic: To avoid serving under Zhongqi, he was transferred to the Left Battalion at Xining.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，授河州協副將，剿定鐵布等寨亂番。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng, he was appointed deputy regional commander of the Hezhou Brigade and suppressed the rebellious tribes of Tiebu and other stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongzheng (1724), he was appointed deputy regional commander of the Hezhou Brigade and suppressed the rebellious tribes of Tiebu and other stockades.

sentences.zh: 又以避鍾琪，改張家口協。

translations.literal: Again to avoid Zhongqi, he was transferred to the Zhangjiakou Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: Again to avoid Zhongqi, he was transferred to the Zhangjiakou Brigade.

sentences.zh: 六年，遷天津總兵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he was transferred to regional commander of Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1728), he was transferred to regional commander of Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 八年，擢湖廣提督。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he was promoted to provincial military commander of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1730), he was promoted to provincial military commander of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 烏蒙亂，超龍令總兵蘇大有率副將何勉、參將毋椿齡討平之。

translations.literal: When Wumeng rose in rebellion, Chao Long ordered Regional Commander Su Dayou to lead Deputy Commander He Mian and Assistant Commander Wu Chunling to suppress and pacify it.
translations.idiomatic: When Wumeng rebelled, Chao Long ordered Regional Commander Su Dayou, with Deputy Commander He Mian and Assistant Commander Wu Chunling, to suppress and pacify it.

sentences.zh: 尋遣兵分防貴州界，上以深合機宜嘉之。

translations.literal: He soon dispatched troops to garrison the Guizhou border in separate detachments; the emperor praised this as deeply in accord with strategic necessity.
translations.idiomatic: He soon sent troops to garrison the Guizhou border in detachments; the emperor praised this as deeply in accord with strategic necessity.

sentences.zh: 十年，卒。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1732), he died.

sentences.zh: 鍾璜，超龍子。

translations.literal: Zhong Huang was Chao Long's son.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Huang was Chao Long's son.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，以鍾琪奏赴西路軍效力，授藍翎侍衛，除鑾儀衛治儀正。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongzheng, on Zhongqi's memorial that he should serve with merit on the western expedition, he was appointed a blue-plume imperial bodyguard and made director of ceremony in the Imperial Procession Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yongzheng (1729), on Zhongqi's memorial that he serve on the western expedition, he was appointed a blue-plume imperial bodyguard and made director of ceremony in the Imperial Procession Guard.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，擢四川威茂營參將。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qianlong reign, he was promoted to assistant regional commander of the Weimao Garrison in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Qianlong reign, he was promoted to assistant regional commander of the Weimao Garrison in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 再遷總兵，歷建寧、南贛、開化、昭通諸鎮。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to regional commander and served successively at Jianning, Nangan, Kaihua, Zhaotong, and other commands.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to regional commander and served at Jianning, Nangan, Kaihua, Zhaotong, and other posts.

sentences.zh: 擢廣西提督，鍾琪卒，代為四川提督。

translations.literal: He was promoted to provincial military commander of Guangxi; when Zhongqi died, he succeeded him as provincial military commander of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to provincial military commander of Guangxi; when Zhongqi died, he succeeded him as provincial military commander of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「松潘總兵例出塞化番，三年一度。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The regional commander at Songpan customarily goes beyond the frontier to pacify the tribes, once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The regional commander at Songpan customarily goes beyond the frontier to pacify the tribes once every three years.

sentences.zh: 番性多猜，調集守候，彼此互防，甚非所原。

translations.literal: The tribes are suspicious by nature; when troops are assembled and held in waiting, each side guards against the other — this is far from what they desire.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes are suspicious by nature; when troops are mustered and held in waiting, each side guards against the other — this is far from what they desire.

sentences.zh: 又見小道遠費鉅，託病不至，惟附近土司領賞，有名無實。

translations.literal: Moreover, the routes are poor and the expense great; they plead illness and do not come, while nearby native officials alone receive rewards — the practice exists in name only.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the routes are poor and the cost great; they plead illness and do not come, while nearby native officials alone receive rewards — the practice exists in name only.

sentences.zh: 請停止，以節勞費。」

translations.literal: I request that it be discontinued to save labor and expense."
translations.idiomatic: I request that it be discontinued to save labor and expense."

sentences.zh: 上從之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 金川土舍郎卡侵革布什咱土司，革布什咱合九土司兵攻金川，相持數年未決，郎卡乞令罷兵。

translations.literal: The Jinchuan native officer Langka invaded the Gewusi Zhan native official; Gewusi Zhan joined nine native officials' armies to attack Jinchuan; for several years they remained deadlocked without resolution; Langka begged that the fighting be halted.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinchuan native officer Langka invaded the Gewusi Zhan native official; Gewusi Zhan rallied nine native officials' forces against Jinchuan; for several years the struggle was unresolved; Langka begged that the fighting cease.

sentences.zh: 鍾璜率兵出塞，至拉必斯滿安營，召郎卡出，令還所侵地及所掠穆爾津岡諸土司番民。

translations.literal: Zhong Huang led troops beyond the frontier to the Labisiman'an encampment, summoned Langka out, and ordered him to return the seized lands and the tribal people of Murjingang and other native officials whom he had carried off.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Huang led troops beyond the frontier to the Labisiman'an encampment, summoned Langka out, and ordered him to return seized lands and the tribal subjects of Murjingang and other native officials whom he had carried off.

sentences.zh: 九土司之兵悉罷。

translations.literal: The armies of all nine native officials were wholly withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: The armies of all nine native officials were wholly withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 旋卒，賜祭葬，諡莊恪。

translations.literal: He soon died; imperial sacrificial rites were granted, and he was given the posthumous name Zhuangke.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died; imperial funeral rites were granted, and he was posthumously named Zhuangke ("Solemn and Respectful").

sentences.zh: 濬，鍾琪子。

translations.literal: Jun was Zhongqi's son.
translations.idiomatic: Jun was Zhongqi's son.

sentences.zh: 以二品廕生授西安同知，擢口北道，再擢山東布政使。

translations.literal: As a second-rank yinsheng he was appointed subprefect of Xi'an, promoted to the Koubei Circuit, and again promoted to Shandong provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: As a second-rank yinsheng he was appointed subprefect of Xi'an, promoted to the Koubei Circuit, and then to Shandong provincial administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 雍正六年，調山西，署山東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yongzheng, he was transferred to Shanxi and acted as governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Yongzheng (1728), he was transferred to Shanxi and acted as governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪出師，命濬送至肅州。

translations.literal: When Zhongqi took the field, Jun was ordered to escort him as far as Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhongqi took the field, Jun was ordered to escort him as far as Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 八年，召鍾琪詣京師，命濬就省。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Zhongqi was summoned to the capital, and Jun was ordered to visit his family.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1730), Zhongqi was summoned to the capital, and Jun was ordered to visit his family.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，請免郯城、蘭山諸縣水沖地應徵丁米。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, he requested exemption of land tax and grain levies on fields washed away by floods in Tancheng, Lanshan, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianlong (1736), he requested exemption of land tax and grain levies on fields washed away by floods in Tancheng, Lanshan, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 尋調江西。

translations.literal: Soon after he was transferred to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 三年，請免南昌府屬浮糧三萬七千餘兩，复疏請發帑修築豐城江堤，濬江關河口，議行社倉，皆允所請。

translations.literal: In the third year, he requested exemption of more than thirty-seven thousand taels of surplus grain levies in the jurisdiction of Nanchang Prefecture; he also memorialized requesting treasury funds to repair the Jiang embankment at Fengcheng, dredge the Jiang Pass river mouth, and establish community granaries — all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1738), he requested exemption of more than thirty-seven thousand taels of surplus grain levies in Nanchang Prefecture; he also memorialized for treasury funds to repair the Jiang embankment at Fengcheng, dredge the Jiang Pass river mouth, and establish community granaries — all were approved.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督楊超曾劾濬與屬吏朋比納賄，坐奪官。

translations.literal: Yang Chaoce, governor-general of Liangjiang, impeached Jun for colluding with subordinates to accept bribes; he was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Chaoce, governor-general of Liangjiang, impeached Jun for colluding with subordinates to accept bribes, and he was stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 六年，授光祿寺卿，出為福建按察使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he was appointed vice minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and sent out as surveillance commissioner of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1741), he was appointed vice minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and sent out as surveillance commissioner of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 再遷廣東巡撫，調雲南。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to governor of Guangdong and transferred to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to governor of Guangdong and transferred to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 兩廣總督陳大受劾濬誤舉糧道明福以婪贓敗，又採木修堤，任屬吏作弊，召還京師。

translations.literal: Chen Dashou, governor-general of Liangguang, impeached Jun for wrongly recommending grain intendant Ming Fu, who was ruined by greedy corruption, and for timber procurement and dike repair in which he let subordinates cheat; he was recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Dashou, governor-general of Liangguang, impeached Jun for wrongly recommending grain intendant Ming Fu, who was ruined by corruption, and for timber procurement and dike repair in which he let subordinates cheat; he was recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十八年，授鴻臚寺少卿，轉通政使參議，卒。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, he was appointed vice minister of the Court of State Ceremonial, transferred to supervising secretary in the Office of Transmission, and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year (1753), he was appointed vice minister of the Court of State Ceremonial, transferred to supervising secretary in the Office of Transmission, and died.

sentences.zh: 濬在巡撫任虧庫項，鍾琪請以公俸按年扣還，上特命免之。

translations.literal: While Jun served as governor he had a deficit in the provincial treasury; Zhongqi requested repayment in annual deductions from his ducal stipend; the emperor specially ordered the debt forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: While Jun served as governor he had a treasury deficit; Zhongqi asked to repay it in annual deductions from his ducal stipend; the emperor specially ordered the debt forgiven.

sentences.zh: 策棱，博爾濟吉特氏，蒙古喀爾喀部人。

translations.literal: Celeng, of the Borjigit clan, was a native of the Khalkha Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng, of the Borjigit clan, was a Khalkha Mongol.

sentences.zh: 元太祖十八世孫圖蒙肯，號班珠爾，興黃教，西藏達賴喇嘛賢之，號曰賽音諾顏。

translations.literal: The eighteenth-generation descendant of Genghis Khan, Tumengken, styled Banzhur, promoted the Yellow Sect; the Dalai Lama of Tibet esteemed him and gave him the title Sain Noyan.
translations.idiomatic: Tumengken, eighteenth-generation descendant of Genghis Khan, styled Banzhur, promoted the Yellow Sect; the Dalai Lama of Tibet esteemed him and gave him the title Sain Noyan.

sentences.zh: 其第八子丹津生納木扎勒，納木扎勒生策棱。

translations.literal: His eighth son Danseng Namjal begat Namjal, and Namjal begat Celeng.
translations.idiomatic: His eighth son Danseng Namjal begat Namjal, and Namjal begat Celeng.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十一年，丹津妻格楚勒哈屯自塔密爾攜策棱及其弟恭格喇布坦來歸，聖祖授策棱三等阿達哈哈番，賜居京師，命入內廷教養。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year of Kangxi, Danseng's wife Getule Hatun came from Tamiar bringing Celeng and his younger brother Gongge Labutan to submit; the Kangxi Emperor granted Celeng the third-rank title of adahahafan, assigned them residence in the capital, and ordered them reared within the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year of Kangxi (1692), Danseng's wife Getule Hatun came from Tamiar bringing Celeng and his younger brother Gongge Labutan to submit; the Kangxi Emperor granted Celeng the third-rank title of adahahafan, gave them residence in the capital, and ordered them reared in the inner court.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，尚聖祖女和碩純愨公主，授和碩額駙。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year, he married the Kangxi Emperor's daughter, the Princess Chunjie, and was invested as imperial son-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year (1706), he married the Kangxi Emperor's daughter, Princess Chunjie, and was invested as imperial son-in-law (efu).

sentences.zh: 尋賜貝子品級，詔攜所屬歸牧塔密爾。

translations.literal: Soon after he was granted the rank of beile and ordered to return with his following to pasture at Tamiar.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was granted the rank of beile and ordered to return with his following to pasture at Tamiar.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，命赴推河從軍，出北路防禦策妄阿喇布坦。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year, he was ordered to join the army on the Tui River and march out on the northern route to defend against Tsewang Arabtan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year (1715), he was ordered to join the army on the Tui River and march on the northern route against Tsewang Arabtan.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，師徵準噶爾，策棱從振武將軍傅爾丹出布拉罕，至格爾額爾格，屢破準噶爾，獲其宰桑貝坤等百餘人，俘馘甚眾。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year, when the army campaigned against the Dzungars, Celeng followed General Furdan of Zhenwu out from Bolahan to Gergel, repeatedly defeated the Dzungars, captured more than a hundred of their zaisang including Beikun, and took many prisoners and heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year (1720), when the army campaigned against the Dzungars, Celeng followed General Furdan of Zhenwu from Bolahan to Gergel, repeatedly defeated the Dzungars, captured more than a hundred of their zaisang including Beikun, and took many prisoners and heads.

sentences.zh: 戰烏蘭呼濟爾，焚敵糧。

translations.literal: At the battle of Ulan Khujir he burned the enemy's grain.
translations.idiomatic: At Ulan Khujir he burned the enemy's grain.

sentences.zh: 師還，道遇準噶爾援兵，复擊敗之，授扎薩克。

translations.literal: On the army's return, they encountered Dzungar reinforcements on the road and again defeated them; he was granted the rank of jasak.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march they met Dzungar reinforcements and again defeated them; he was granted the rank of jasak.

sentences.zh: 策棱生長漠外，從軍久，習知山川險易。

translations.literal: Celeng had grown up beyond the frontier deserts; he had campaigned long and was thoroughly familiar with the difficult and easy points of the terrain.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng had grown up beyond the frontier; he had campaigned long and knew every difficult and easy point of the terrain.

sentences.zh: 憤喀爾喀為準噶爾凌藉，銳自磨厲，練猛士千，隸帳下為親兵。

translations.literal: Angered that the Khalkha had been trampled by the Dzungars, he honed himself keenly, drilled a thousand fierce warriors, and attached them to his personal command as household troops.
translations.idiomatic: Angered that the Khalkha had been trampled by the Dzungars, he trained himself relentlessly, drilled a thousand fierce warriors, and kept them as his personal guard.

sentences.zh: 又以敵善馳突而喀爾喀無紀律節制，每遊獵及止而駐軍，皆以兵法部勒之，居常欽欽如臨大敵。

translations.literal: Moreover, because the enemy excelled at swift raids while the Khalkha lacked discipline and control, whether on hunting excursions or when halting to encamp, he always arrayed them by military method; in daily life they were as taut as if facing a great enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Because the enemy excelled at swift raids while the Khalkha lacked discipline, whether hunting or encamping he always arrayed them by military method; in daily life they were as taut as if facing a great battle.

sentences.zh: 由是賽音諾顏一軍雄漠北。

translations.literal: Thus the Sain Noyan army became supreme on the northern desert.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Sain Noyan army became supreme on the northern steppe.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，世宗特詔封多羅郡王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, the emperor issued a special edict enfeoffing him as prince of the second degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongzheng (1723), the emperor issued a special edict enfeoffing him as prince of the second degree (duoluo junwang).

sentences.zh: 二年，入覲，命偕同族親王丹津多爾濟駐阿爾泰，並授副將軍，詔策棱用正黃旗纛。

translations.literal: In the second year, on audience he was ordered to garrison the Altai together with his kinsman Prince Danseng Dorji and was concurrently appointed deputy commander-in-chief; an edict directed that Celeng use the Plain Yellow Banner standard.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year (1724), on audience he was ordered to garrison the Altai with his kinsman Prince Danseng Dorji and was appointed deputy commander-in-chief; an edict directed that Celeng use the Plain Yellow Banner standard.

sentences.zh: 五年，偕內大臣四格等赴楚庫河，與俄羅斯使薩瓦立石定界，事畢，陳兵鳴砲謝天，議罪當削爵，上命改罰俸。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, together with Inner Court minister Sige and others he went to the Chukur River to erect boundary markers with the Russian envoy Savva; when the business was done they drew up troops and fired cannon in thanks to Heaven; on deliberation the offense warranted deprivation of rank, but the emperor ordered commutation to forfeiture of stipend.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1727), with Inner Court minister Sige and others he went to the Chukur River to set boundary markers with the Russian envoy Savva; when the work was done they drew up troops and fired cannon in thanks to Heaven; deliberation held the offense merited deprivation of rank, but the emperor commuted it to forfeiture of stipend.

sentences.zh: 九年，從靖邊大將軍順承郡王錫保討噶爾丹策零，偵賊自和通呼爾哈諾爾窺圖壘、茂海、奎素諸界，偕翁牛特部貝子羅卜藏等分兵擊卻之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, following Border-pacifying Grand General Prince Shuncheng Xibao against Galdan Tseren, he detected the enemy probing from Hoton Khorkhu Nuur toward Tulei, Maohai, Kuisu, and other borders; with the Beile Lobzang of the Ujimchin and others he divided forces and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1731), following Border-pacifying Grand General Prince Shuncheng Xibao against Galdan Tseren, he detected the enemy probing from Hoton Khorkhu Nuur toward Tulei, Maohai, Kuisu, and other borders; with Beile Lobzang of the Ujimchin and others he divided forces and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾諸酋有大策零敦多卜、小策零敦多卜，皆噶爾丹策零同族，最用事。

translations.literal: Among the Dzungar chiefs were Dawachi Dondup and Xiaozereng Dondup, both of Galdan Tseren's clan and the most influential.
translations.idiomatic: Among the Dzungar chiefs were Dawachi Dondup and Xiaozereng Dondup, both of Galdan Tseren's clan and the most influential.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹策零遣大策零敦多卜將三萬人入掠喀爾喀，聞錫保駐察罕廋爾，振武將軍傅爾丹軍科布多，乃遣其將海倫曼濟等將六千人取道阿爾泰迤東，分擾克魯倫及鄂爾海喀喇烏蘇，留餘眾於蘇克阿勒達呼為聲援。

translations.literal: Galdan Tseren sent Dawachi Dondup with thirty thousand men to raid the Khalkha; learning that Xibao was at Chaghan Ulir and General Furdan at Kobdo, he sent his generals Helen Manji and others with six thousand men by the Altai route eastward to harass the Kerulen and Erkhe Khara Usu in separate columns, leaving the remainder at Suke Eldahu as support.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan Tseren sent Dawachi Dondup with thirty thousand men to raid the Khalkha; learning that Xibao was at Chaghan Ulir and General Furdan at Kobdo, he sent his generals Helen Manji and others with six thousand by the Altai route east to harass the Kerulen and Erkhe Khara Usu in separate columns, leaving the rest at Suke Eldahu in support.

sentences.zh: 策棱偕丹津多爾濟迎擊，至鄂登楚勒，遣台吉巴海將六百人宵入敵營，誘之出追，伏兵突擊，斬其驍將，餘眾驚潰，大策零敦多卜及海倫曼濟等遁去。

translations.literal: Celeng with Danseng Dorji went to meet them; at Odontchel he sent taiji Bahai with six hundred men to infiltrate the enemy camp by night, lure them out in pursuit, and spring an ambush; they beheaded the enemy's fierce general, the rest fled in panic, and Dawachi Dondup, Helen Manji, and others escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng with Danseng Dorji went to meet them; at Odontchel he sent taiji Bahai with six hundred men to infiltrate the enemy camp by night, lure them out, and spring an ambush; they beheaded the enemy's fierce general, the rest fled in panic, and Dawachi Dondup, Helen Manji, and others escaped.

sentences.zh: 詔進封和碩親王，賜白金萬。

translations.literal: An edict promoted him to prince of the first degree and granted ten thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: An edict promoted him to prince of the first degree (heshuo qinwang) and granted ten thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 尋授喀爾喀大扎薩克。

translations.literal: Soon after he was appointed Grand Jasak of the Khalkha.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was appointed Grand Jasak of the Khalkha.

sentences.zh: 十年六月，噶爾丹策零遣小策零敦多卜將三萬人自奇蘭至額爾德畢喇色欽，策棱偕將軍塔爾岱青禦於本博圖山。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the tenth year, Galdan Tseren sent Xiaozereng Dondup with thirty thousand men from Qilan to Erdeni Bile Sechin; Celeng with General Tarda joined to resist at Bonboto Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the tenth year (1732), Galdan Tseren sent Xiaozereng Dondup with thirty thousand men from Qilan to Erdeni Bile Sechin; Celeng with General Tarda moved to resist at Bonboto Mountain.

sentences.zh: 未至，準噶爾掠克爾森齊老，分兵襲塔密爾，掠策棱二子及牲畜以去。

translations.literal: Before they arrived, the Dzungars raided Kersenchilao, split forces to strike Tamiar, and carried off Celeng's two sons and his livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Before they arrived, the Dzungars raided Kersenchilao, split forces to strike Tamiar, and carried off Celeng's two sons and his livestock.

sentences.zh: 策棱不及援，侍郎綽爾鐸以轉餉至，語策棱曰：「王速率兵遏敵歸路，當大破敵。」

translations.literal: Celeng could not arrive in time to relieve them; Vice Minister Chuo'erduo, arriving with transport grain, said to Celeng: "Your Highness, hurry your troops to block the enemy's line of retreat — you will inflict a great defeat."
translations.idiomatic: Celeng could not arrive in time; Vice Minister Chuo'erduo, arriving with transport grain, said to Celeng: "Your Highness, hurry your troops to block the enemy's line of retreat — you will inflict a great defeat."

sentences.zh: 策棱還軍馳擊，距敵二日程。

translations.literal: Celeng turned his army and pursued at speed, coming within two days' march of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng turned his army and pursued at speed, coming within two days' march of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 初，招丹津多爾濟赴援，不至。

translations.literal: Earlier he had summoned Danseng Dorji to reinforce him, but he did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier he had summoned Danseng Dorji to reinforce him, but he did not come.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾兵趨額爾德尼昭，八月，策棱率兵追敵，十餘戰，敵屢敗。

translations.literal: The Dzungar army pressed toward Erdeni Juu; in the eighth month Celeng led troops in pursuit, fought more than ten engagements, and the enemy was repeatedly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The Dzungar army pressed toward Erdeni Juu; in the eighth month Celeng led troops in pursuit, fought more than ten engagements, and the enemy was repeatedly defeated.

sentences.zh: 小策零敦多卜據杭愛山麓，逼鄂爾坤河而陣；

translations.literal: Xiaozereng Dondup held the foothills of the Khangai Mountains and drew up his battle line pressing the Orkhon River;
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozereng Dondup held the foothills of the Khangai Mountains and drew up his line along the Orkhon River;

sentences.zh: 策棱令滿洲兵陣河南，而率萬人伏山側，蒙古諸軍陣河北，遂戰。

translations.literal: Celeng ordered the Manchu troops to form battle line south of the river, while he himself led ten thousand men in ambush on the mountainside; the Mongol armies formed line north of the river, and battle was joined.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng ordered the Manchu troops to form line south of the river while he led ten thousand men in ambush on the mountainside; the Mongol armies formed north of the river, and battle was joined.

sentences.zh: 敵見滿洲兵背水陣，兵甚弱，意輕之，越險進。

translations.literal: The enemy saw the Manchu troops in a line with their backs to the water, their force very weak, and despised them; they crossed the difficult ground and advanced.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy saw the Manchu troops backed against the water, their force seemingly weak, and despised them; they crossed the difficult ground and advanced.

sentences.zh: 滿洲兵卻走，準噶爾兵逐之，策棱伏起自山下，如風雨至，斬萬餘級，谷中屍為滿，獲牲畜、器械無算。

translations.literal: The Manchu troops feigned retreat; the Dzungar troops pursued them; Celeng's ambush rose from the mountainside like wind and rain, beheaded more than ten thousand, filled the valley with corpses, and captured livestock and weapons beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: The Manchu troops feigned retreat and the Dzungars pursued; Celeng's ambush rose from the mountainside like a storm, killing more than ten thousand, filling the valley with corpses, and capturing livestock and weapons beyond count.

sentences.zh: 小策零敦多卜以餘眾渡河，蒙古兵待其半渡擊之，多入水死，河流盡赤。

translations.literal: Xiaozereng Dondup with the remnant force crossed the river; the Mongol troops waited until they were half across and struck; many drowned, and the river ran red.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozereng Dondup crossed the river with the remnant; the Mongols struck when they were half across; many drowned and the river ran red.

sentences.zh: 錫保馳疏告捷，首表策棱功，上嘉悅，賜號超勇，錫黃帶。

translations.literal: Xibao sent a rapid memorial reporting victory, listing Celeng's merit first; the emperor was pleased, granted him the name Chaoyong, and bestowed the yellow belt.
translations.idiomatic: Xibao sent a rapid memorial reporting victory, listing Celeng's merit first; the emperor was pleased, granted him the name Chaoyong ("Surpassing Courage"), and bestowed the yellow belt.

sentences.zh: 諭：「此次軍功非尋常勞績可比，隨徵兵弁，著從優加倍議敘。」

translations.literal: An edict said: "This military achievement is not comparable to ordinary merit; the officers and soldiers who took part in the campaign shall be rewarded with doubled preferment."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "This military achievement is not comparable to ordinary merit; the officers and soldiers who took part shall be rewarded with doubled preferment."

sentences.zh: 上以策棱牧地被寇，賚馬二千、牛千、羊五千、白金五萬，賑所屬失業者，並命城塔密爾，建第居之。

translations.literal: Because Celeng's pasturelands had been raided, the emperor granted two thousand horses, a thousand cattle, five thousand sheep, fifty thousand taels of silver, relief for his followers who had lost their livelihood, and ordered a walled town built at Tamiar with a residence for him.
translations.idiomatic: Because Celeng's pasturelands had been raided, the emperor granted two thousand horses, a thousand cattle, five thousand sheep, fifty thousand taels of silver, relief for his followers who had lost their livelihood, and ordered a walled town built at Tamiar with a residence for him.

sentences.zh: 十二月，進固倫額駙，時純愨公主已薨，追贈固倫長公主。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was advanced to gulun efu; the Princess Chunjie had already died, and was posthumously raised to gulun chang gongzhu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was advanced to gulun efu; Princess Chunjie had already died and was posthumously raised to gulun chang gongzhu.

sentences.zh: 十一年，定邊大將軍平郡王福彭統軍駐烏里雅蘇台，詔策棱佩定邊左副將軍印，進屯科布多，尋授盟長。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Border-pacifying Grand General Prince Ping Fupeng commanded the army at Uliastai; an edict directed Celeng to wear the seal of Left Deputy Border-pacifying General, advance to garrison Kobdo, and soon appointed him league chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1733), Border-pacifying Grand General Prince Ping Fupeng commanded at Uliastai; an edict directed Celeng to wear the seal of Left Deputy Border-pacifying General, advance to Kobdo, and soon appointed him league chief.

sentences.zh: 十二年五月，召來京諮軍務。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, fifth month, he was summoned to the capital to consult on military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, fifth month, he was summoned to the capital to consult on military affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月，移軍察罕廋爾。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the army moved to Chaghan Ulir.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the army moved to Chaghan Ulir.

sentences.zh: 十三年，準噶爾乞和，請以哲爾格西喇呼魯甦為喀爾喀游牧界，上諮策棱。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the Dzungars sued for peace and requested that Zhergesi Khurusu be the Khalkha pasturage boundary; the emperor consulted Celeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year the Dzungars sued for peace and requested Zhergesi Khurusu as the Khalkha pasturage boundary; the emperor consulted Celeng.

sentences.zh: 策棱謂：「向者喀爾喀游牧尚未至哲爾格西喇呼魯甦，此議可許。

translations.literal: Celeng said: "Formerly Khalkha pasturage had not yet reached Zhergesi Khurusu; this proposal may be allowed.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng said: "Formerly Khalkha pasturage had not yet reached Zhergesi Khurusu; this proposal may be allowed.

sentences.zh: 惟準噶爾游牧，必以阿爾泰山為界，空其中為甌脫。」

translations.literal: Only Dzungar pasturage must take the Altai Mountains as boundary, leaving the space between as a buffer zone."
translations.idiomatic: Only Dzungar pasturage must take the Altai Mountains as boundary, leaving the space between as a buffer zone."

sentences.zh: 準噶爾不從。

translations.literal: The Dzungars did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The Dzungars did not agree.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，師還，命策棱將喀爾喀兵千五百人駐烏里雅蘇台，分防鄂爾坤。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong the army returned; Celeng was ordered to lead fifteen hundred Khalkha troops to garrison Uliastai and guard the Orkhon in detachments.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianlong (1736) the army returned; Celeng was ordered to lead fifteen hundred Khalkha troops to garrison Uliastai and guard the Orkhon in detachments.

sentences.zh: 上以策棱母居京師，策棱在軍久，不得朝夕定省，命送歸游牧，並賜白金五千治裝。

translations.literal: Because Celeng's mother lived in the capital and Celeng had been long on campaign without daily attendance, the emperor ordered her sent back to the pastures and granted five thousand taels of silver for travel expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Because Celeng's mother lived in the capital and he had been long on campaign without daily attendance, the emperor ordered her sent back to the pastures and granted five thousand taels for travel expenses.

sentences.zh: 二年，噶爾丹策零貽書策棱，稱為車臣汗，申前請。

translations.literal: In the second year Galdan Tseren sent a letter to Celeng, calling him Sechen Khan and renewing the earlier request.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year (1737) Galdan Tseren sent a letter to Celeng, calling him Sechen Khan and renewing the earlier request.

sentences.zh: 策棱以聞，上命策棱以己意為報書，書曰：「阿爾泰為天定邊界。

translations.literal: Celeng reported this; the emperor ordered Celeng to reply in his own words; the letter said: "The Altai is the boundary fixed by Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng reported this; the emperor ordered him to reply in his own words; the letter said: "The Altai is the boundary fixed by Heaven.

sentences.zh: 爾父琿台吉時，阿爾泰迤西初無厄魯特游牧。

translations.literal: In your father Galdan's time, west of the Altai there was at first no Oirat pasturage.
translations.idiomatic: In your father Galdan's time, west of the Altai there was at first no Oirat pasturage.

sentences.zh: 自滅噶爾丹，我來建城，駐兵其地，眾所共知。

translations.literal: Since Galdan was destroyed, we came to build cities and station troops there — this is known to all.
translations.idiomatic: Since Galdan was destroyed, we came to build cities and station troops there — this is known to all.

sentences.zh: 其不令爾游牧者，原欲以此為隙地，兩不相及，以息爭端。

translations.literal: That you are not allowed to pasture there was originally intended to make this a neutral ground, so the two sides would not touch and strife would cease.
translations.idiomatic: That you are not allowed to pasture there was originally intended to make this neutral ground, so the two sides would not touch and strife would cease.

sentences.zh: 今台吉反雲難以讓給，試思阿爾泰為誰地，誰能讓給？

translations.literal: Now the taiji says it is hard to yield — consider whose land the Altai is; who can yield it to whom?
translations.idiomatic: Now the taiji says it is hard to yield — consider whose land the Altai is; who can yield it to whom?

sentences.zh: 爾誠遵上指定議，我必不為禍始，亦不復居科布多。

translations.literal: If you truly follow the emperor's fixed settlement, I shall certainly not be the first to make trouble, nor shall I again remain at Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: If you truly follow the emperor's fixed settlement, I shall certainly not be the first to make trouble, nor shall I again remain at Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 又謂我等哨兵逼近阿爾泰，宜向內撤。

translations.literal: You also say our scouts have drawn too near the Altai and should withdraw inward.
translations.idiomatic: You also say our scouts have drawn too near the Altai and should withdraw inward.

sentences.zh: 哨兵乃聖祖時舊例，即定界，豈能不設？

translations.literal: Scouts are an old practice from the Kangxi reign; once the boundary is fixed, how can they not be posted?
translations.idiomatic: Scouts are an old practice from the Kangxi reign; once the boundary is fixed, how can they not be posted?

sentences.zh: 台吉其思之！」

translations.literal: Let the taiji consider this!"
translations.idiomatic: Let the taiji consider this!"

sentences.zh: 冬，準噶爾使達甚博爾濟奉表至，命策棱偕詣京師。

translations.literal: In winter the Dzungar envoy Dashen Boerji presented a memorial; Celeng was ordered to accompany him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In winter the Dzungar envoy Dashen Boerji presented a memorial; Celeng was ordered to accompany him to the capital.

sentences.zh: 三年春，至京師。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, they reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, spring, they reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹策零表請喀爾喀與準噶爾各照現在駐牧。

translations.literal: Galdan Tseren memorialized requesting that Khalkha and Dzungar each keep their present pastures.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan Tseren memorialized requesting that Khalkha and Dzungar each keep their present pastures.

sentences.zh: 上召達甚博爾濟入見，諭曰：「蒙古游牧，冬夏隨時遷徙。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned Dashen Boerji for audience and instructed: "Mongol pasturage shifts with the seasons between winter and summer.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned Dashen Boerji for audience and instructed: "Mongol pasturage shifts with the seasons between winter and summer.

sentences.zh: 必指定山河為界，彼此毋得逾越。」

translations.literal: Mountains and rivers must be designated as boundaries so neither side may cross."
translations.idiomatic: Mountains and rivers must be designated as boundaries so neither side may cross."

sentences.zh: 遣侍郎阿克敦等使準噶爾，與達甚博爾濟偕往。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Akedun and others were sent as envoys to the Dzungars, traveling with Dashen Boerji.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Akedun and others were sent as envoys to the Dzungars, traveling with Dashen Boerji.

sentences.zh: 冬，噶爾丹策零復使哈柳從阿克敦等奉表至，請循布延圖河，南以博爾濟昂吉勒圖、無克克嶺噶克察諸地為界，北以遜多爾庫奎、多爾多輝庫奎至哈爾奇喇博木、喀喇巴爾楚克諸地為界，準噶爾人不越阿爾泰山，蒙古居山前，亦止在扎卜堪諸地，兩不相接。

translations.literal: In winter Galdan Tseren again sent Halu with Akedun and others presenting a memorial, requesting along the Buyant River: south to Borj Anggil Tu, Wukeke Linggakecha, and other places as boundary; north to Sundor Kui, Dordo Hui Kui to Kharchira Bomu, Khara Barchuk, and other places as boundary; Dzungars not to cross the Altai Mountains, Mongols to remain before the mountains and only as far as Zhabkan and other places, the two sides not to meet.
translations.idiomatic: In winter Galdan Tseren again sent Halu with Akedun and others presenting a memorial, requesting along the Buyant River: south to Borj Anggil Tu, Wukeke Linggakecha, and other places as boundary; north to Sundor Kui, Dordo Hui Kui to Kharchira Bomu, Khara Barchuk, and other places as boundary; Dzungars not to cross the Altai Mountains, Mongols to remain before the mountains only as far as Zhabkan and other places, the two sides not to meet.

sentences.zh: 並乞移托爾和、布延圖二卡倫入內地。

translations.literal: He also begged to move the Torghut and Buyant River two border posts inland.
translations.idiomatic: He also begged to move the Torghut and Buyant River two border posts inland.

sentences.zh: 上以所議準噶爾不越阿爾泰山定界已就範，惟移托爾和、布延圖二卡倫不可許。

translations.literal: The emperor held that the Dzungars' not crossing the Altai to fix the boundary was already within bounds, but moving the Torghut and Buyant River two posts could not be allowed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that the Dzungars' not crossing the Altai to fix the boundary was already within bounds, but moving the Torghut and Buyant River two posts could not be allowed.

sentences.zh: 四年春，賜敕遣還。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, an imperial letter was granted and they were sent back.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, spring, an imperial letter was granted and they were sent back.

sentences.zh: 哈柳詣策棱，哈柳曰：「額駙游牧部屬在喀爾喀，何弗居彼？」

translations.literal: Halu called on Celeng; Halu said: "The efu's pastoral followers are in the Khalkha — why do you not live there?"
translations.idiomatic: Halu called on Celeng; Halu said: "The efu's pastoral followers are in the Khalkha — why do you not live there?"

sentences.zh: 策棱答曰：「我主居此，予惟隨主居。

translations.literal: Celeng answered: "My lord dwells here; I only dwell where my lord dwells.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng answered: "My lord dwells here; I only dwell where my lord dwells.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀特予游牧耳！」

translations.literal: The Khalkha merely granted me pasturage!"
translations.idiomatic: The Khalkha merely granted me pasturage!"

sentences.zh: 哈柳又曰：「額駙有子在準噶爾，何不令來京？」

translations.literal: Halu also said: "The efu has a son in the Dzungar lands — why not have him come to the capital?"
translations.idiomatic: Halu also said: "The efu has a son in the Dzungar lands — why not have him come to the capital?"

sentences.zh: 答曰：「予蒙恩尚公主，公主所出乃予子，他子無與也。

translations.literal: He answered: "I received the grace of marriage to the princess; only the princess's son is my son — other sons have nothing to do with me.
translations.idiomatic: He answered: "I received the grace of marriage to the princess; only the princess's son is my son — other sons have nothing to do with me.

sentences.zh: 即爾送還，予必請於上誅之。」

translations.literal: Even if you sent him back, I would certainly beg the emperor to execute him."
translations.idiomatic: Even if you sent him back, I would certainly beg the emperor to execute him."

sentences.zh: 冬，噶爾丹策零使哈柳复奉表至，始定議準噶爾不過阿爾泰山梁，不復言徙卡倫事。

translations.literal: In winter Galdan Tseren sent Halu again with a memorial; the settlement was finally fixed that the Dzungars would not cross the Altai ridge, and they no longer spoke of moving the border posts.
translations.idiomatic: In winter Galdan Tseren sent Halu again with a memorial; the settlement was finally fixed that the Dzungars would not cross the Altai ridge, and they no longer spoke of moving the border posts.

sentences.zh: 自雍正間與準噶爾議界，策棱三詣京師，準噶爾憚其威重，卒如上指。

translations.literal: From the Yongzheng reign boundary negotiations with the Dzungars, Celeng went three times to the capital; the Dzungars feared his authority and finally complied as directed.
translations.idiomatic: From the Yongzheng reign boundary negotiations with the Dzungars, Celeng went three times to the capital; the Dzungars feared his authority and finally complied as directed.

sentences.zh: 上獎策棱忠，子陷準噶爾，不復以為念，乃用宗室親王例，封其子成袞扎布世子。

translations.literal: The emperor rewarded Celeng's loyalty; though his sons were trapped in the Dzungar lands, he no longer dwelt on it, and by the precedent for imperial clansmen invested as princes, enfeoffed his son Chenggun Zhabu as heir.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rewarded Celeng's loyalty; though his sons were trapped in the Dzungar lands, he no longer dwelt on it, and by the precedent for imperial clansmen invested his son Chenggun Zhabu as heir.

sentences.zh: 五年，命勘定喀爾喀游牧，毋越扎布堪、齊克慎、哈薩克圖、庫克嶺諸地，與準噶爾各守定界。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was ordered to survey Khalkha pasturage so it would not cross Zhabkan, Qikechen, Hasaketu, Kukeling, and other places, each side guarding the fixed boundary.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1740) he was ordered to survey Khalkha pasturage so it would not cross Zhabkan, Qikechen, Hasaketu, Kukeling, and other places, each side guarding the fixed boundary.

sentences.zh: 六年，上以策棱老，命移軍駐塔密爾。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, because Celeng was old, he was ordered to move his army to garrison Tamiar.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1741), because Celeng was old, he was ordered to move his army to garrison Tamiar.

sentences.zh: 初，喀爾喀凡三部；

translations.literal: Earlier the Khalkha had three divisions;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Khalkha had three divisions;

sentences.zh: 及是，土謝圖汗十七旗滋息至三十八旗，乃分二十旗與策棱，為賽音諾顏部。

translations.literal: by this time the Tushiyetu Khan's seventeen banners had grown to thirty-eight; twenty banners were divided off to Celeng as the Sain Noyan division.
translations.idiomatic: by this time the Tushiyetu Khan's seventeen banners had grown to thirty-eight; twenty banners were divided off to Celeng as the Sain Noyan division.

sentences.zh: 以鄂爾昆河西北烏里雅蘇河為游牧，為三部屏蔽。

translations.literal: With pasturage northwest of the Orkhon at the Wuliassu River, it served as a shield for the three divisions.
translations.idiomatic: With pasturage northwest of the Orkhon at the Wuliassu River, it served as a shield for the three divisions.

sentences.zh: 自此喀爾喀為四部。

translations.literal: From this the Khalkha became four divisions.
translations.idiomatic: From this the Khalkha became four divisions.

sentences.zh: 十五年，病篤，上遣其次子車布登扎布還侍，使侍衛德山等往存問。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, gravely ill, the emperor sent his second son Chebudeng Zhabu back to attend him and dispatched bodyguards Deshan and others to inquire after his health.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1750), gravely ill, the emperor sent his second son Chebudeng Zhabu back to attend him and dispatched bodyguards Deshan and others to inquire after his health.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，遺言請與純愨公主合葬。

translations.literal: He soon died, leaving a request to be buried with Princess Chunjie.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died, leaving a request to be buried with Princess Chunjie.

sentences.zh: 喪至京師，上親臨奠，命配享太廟，諡曰襄，御製詩輓之。

translations.literal: When the funeral reached the capital, the emperor came in person to offer sacrifice, ordered him enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, posthumously named Xiang, and composed an elegiac poem.
translations.idiomatic: When the funeral reached the capital, the emperor came in person to offer sacrifice, ordered him enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, posthumously named Xiang, and composed an elegiac poem.

sentences.zh: 子八，最著者長子成袞扎布，次子車布登扎布。

translations.literal: He had eight sons; the most notable were the eldest Chenggun Zhabu and the second Chebudeng Zhabu.
translations.idiomatic: He had eight sons; the most notable were the eldest Chenggun Zhabu and the second Chebudeng Zhabu.

sentences.zh: 成袞扎布，初授一等台吉。

translations.literal: Chenggun Zhabu was at first appointed a first-rank taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Chenggun Zhabu was at first appointed a first-rank taiji.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，封固山貝子。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he was enfeoffed as gushan beizi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianlong (1736) he was enfeoffed as gushan beizi.

sentences.zh: 四年，封世子，賜杏黃轡。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was enfeoffed as heir and granted an apricot-yellow bridle.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (1739) he was enfeoffed as heir and granted an apricot-yellow bridle.

sentences.zh: 十五年，襲扎薩克親王兼盟長，授定邊左副將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he inherited the jasak princedom and league chieftainship and was appointed Left Deputy Border-pacifying General.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1750) he inherited the jasak princedom and league chieftainship and was appointed Left Deputy Border-pacifying General.

sentences.zh: 十七年，入覲。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he had audience at court.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year (1752) he had audience at court.

sentences.zh: 十八年，杜爾伯特台吉車凌等內附，成袞扎布遣兵赴烏里雅蘇台防準噶爾追兵。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, when the Dorbet taiji Che Ling and others submitted, Chenggun Zhabu sent troops to Uliastai to guard against Dzungar pursuers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year (1753), when the Dorbet taiji Che Ling and others submitted, Chenggun Zhabu sent troops to Uliastai to guard against Dzungar pursuers.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾宰桑禡木特以二百人追入邊，上命毋縱使還。

translations.literal: The Dzungar zaisang Tamete pursued with two hundred men into the border; the emperor ordered that they not be allowed to escape.
translations.idiomatic: The Dzungar zaisang Tamete pursued with two hundred men into the border; the emperor ordered that they not be allowed to escape.

sentences.zh: 禡木特逸去，詔以責成袞扎布。

translations.literal: Tamete escaped; an edict held Chenggun Zhabu responsible.
translations.idiomatic: Tamete escaped; an edict held Chenggun Zhabu responsible.

sentences.zh: 十九年，命移軍烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was ordered to move his army to Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year (1754) he was ordered to move his army to Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 尋罷定邊左副將軍，命赴額爾齊斯督屯田。

translations.literal: Soon after he was dismissed as Left Deputy Border-pacifying General and ordered to go to the Irtysh to supervise military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was dismissed as Left Deputy Border-pacifying General and ordered to go to the Irtysh to supervise military colonies.

sentences.zh: 二十年，師定伊犁，屯田兵撤還，仍駐烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, when the army pacified Ili, the colony troops were withdrawn and he again garrisoned Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year (1755), when the army pacified Ili, the colony troops were withdrawn and he again garrisoned Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，和托輝特青袞咱卜謀為亂，成袞扎布發其謀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, Qinggun Zhabu of the Khotogoid plotted rebellion; Chenggun Zhabu exposed the plot.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year (1756), Qinggun Zhabu of the Khotogoid plotted rebellion; Chenggun Zhabu exposed the plot.

sentences.zh: 八月，亂作，仍授定邊左副將軍，率師討之，賜三眼孔雀翎。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, when the rebellion broke out, he was again appointed Left Deputy Border-pacifying General, led troops to suppress it, and was granted the three-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, when the rebellion broke out, he was again appointed Left Deputy Border-pacifying General, led troops to suppress it, and was granted the three-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 十二月，獲青袞咱卜，賜杏黃帶。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Qinggun Zhabu was captured; he was granted the apricot-yellow belt.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Qinggun Zhabu was captured; he was granted the apricot-yellow belt.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，輝特巴雅爾為亂，正月，授定邊將軍，率師赴巴里坤捕治。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, when the Khoit Bayar rebelled, in the first month he was appointed Border-pacifying General and led troops to Barkul to capture and punish him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year (1757), when the Khoit Bayar rebelled, in the first month he was appointed Border-pacifying General and led troops to Barkul to capture and punish him.

sentences.zh: 十二月，入覲，复授定邊左副將軍，駐烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he had audience at court; he was again appointed Left Deputy Border-pacifying General and garrisoned Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he had audience at court; he was again appointed Left Deputy Border-pacifying General and garrisoned Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，以準噶爾及回部悉平，請展喀爾喀汛界，下軍機大臣議，以附近烏魯木齊四汛，令索倫、綠旗兵駐防；

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, because the Dzungar and Muslim regions were wholly pacified, he requested extension of the Khalkha patrol boundary; the Grand Council deliberated and assigned the four posts near Urumqi to Solon and Green Standard garrisons;
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year (1761), because the Dzungar and Muslim regions were wholly pacified, he requested extension of the Khalkha patrol boundary; the Grand Council deliberated and assigned the four posts near Urumqi to Solon and Green Standard garrisons;

sentences.zh: 自蘇伯昂阿至烏拉克沁伯勒齊爾十一汛，令成袞扎布督理。

translations.literal: from Subeng Ang'a to Ulakchin Boleqir, eleven posts, Chenggun Zhabu was ordered to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: from Subeng Ang'a to Ulakchin Boleqir, eleven posts, Chenggun Zhabu was ordered to supervise.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，入覲。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he had audience at court.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year (1763) he had audience at court.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，以烏里雅蘇台城圮，請築城，舊址外立木柵，內實以土，引水環之，報聞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, because the Uliastai walls had collapsed, he requested rebuilding; outside the old site a wooden palisade was erected, filled within with earth, and water led around it; the report was acknowledged.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year (1764), because the Uliastai walls had collapsed, he requested rebuilding; outside the old site a wooden palisade was erected, filled within with earth, and water led around it; the report was acknowledged.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，卒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year (1771) he died.

sentences.zh: 子七，獲青袞咱卜，封其第四子佔楚布多爾濟為世子，代掌扎薩克。

translations.literal: He had seven sons; for capturing Qinggun Zhabu his fourth son Zhan Chub Dorji was enfeoffed as heir to hold the jasak in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: He had seven sons; for capturing Qinggun Zhabu his fourth son Zhan Chub Dorji was enfeoffed as heir to hold the jasak in his stead.

sentences.zh: 卒，命其長子輔國公額爾克沙喇代掌扎薩克。

translations.literal: On his death the emperor ordered his eldest son, Defender of the State Duke Erke Shara, to hold the jasak in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: On his death the emperor ordered his eldest son, Defender of the State Duke Erke Shara, to hold the jasak in his stead.

sentences.zh: 卒，命次子輔國公伊什扎卜楚代掌扎薩克。

translations.literal: On his death the emperor ordered the second son, Defender of the State Duke Ish Zhabuchu, to hold the jasak in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: On his death the emperor ordered the second son, Defender of the State Duke Ish Zhabuchu, to hold the jasak in his stead.

sentences.zh: 及成袞扎布卒，以第七子拉旺多爾濟襲扎薩克親王。

translations.literal: When Chenggun Zhabu died, the seventh son Lawang Dorji inherited the jasak princedom.
translations.idiomatic: When Chenggun Zhabu died, the seventh son Lawang Dorji inherited the jasak princedom.

sentences.zh: 拉旺多爾​​濟，尚高宗女固倫和靜公主，授固倫額駙。

translations.literal: Lawang Dorji married the Gaozong Emperor's daughter, Princess Gulun Hejing, and was invested as gulun efu.
translations.idiomatic: Lawang Dorji married the Gaozong Emperor's daughter, Princess Gulun Hejing, and was invested as gulun efu.

sentences.zh: 從征臨清、石峰堡有功。

translations.literal: He had merit in the campaigns at Linqing and Shifengbao.
translations.idiomatic: He had merit in the campaigns at Linqing and Shifengbao.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶八年閏二月，仁宗乘輿入順貞門，有陳德者伏門側突出，侍衛丹巴多爾濟御之，被三創，拉旺多爾濟捘其腕，乃獲而誅之，賜御用補褂，封其子巴彥濟爾噶勒輔國公。

translations.literal: In the intercalary second month of the eighth year of Jiaqing, the Renzong Emperor rode in the imperial carriage through Shunzhen Gate; a man named Chen De sprang out from beside the gate; bodyguard Danba Dorji met him and received three wounds; Lawang Dorji seized his wrist and he was captured and executed; an imperial supplementary jacket was granted, and his son Bayan Jirgal was enfeoffed Defender of the State Duke.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month of the eighth year of Jiaqing (1803), the Renzong Emperor rode through Shunzhen Gate; Chen De sprang out from beside the gate; bodyguard Danba Dorji met him and received three wounds; Lawang Dorji seized his wrist and he was captured and executed; an imperial supplementary jacket was granted, and his son Bayan Jirgal was enfeoffed Defender of the State Duke.

sentences.zh: 車布登扎布，初授一等台吉。

translations.literal: Chebudeng Zhabu was at first appointed a first-rank taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Chebudeng Zhabu was at first appointed a first-rank taiji.

sentences.zh: 額爾德尼昭之役，力戰被創，封輔國公，賜雙眼孔雀翎。

translations.literal: In the Erdeni Juu campaign he fought fiercely and was wounded; he was enfeoffed Defender of the State Duke and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the Erdeni Juu campaign he fought fiercely and was wounded; he was enfeoffed Defender of the State Duke and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 十七年，成袞扎布請析所部授車布登扎布自為一旗，上允之，別授扎薩克。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Chenggun Zhabu requested that part of his following be granted to Chebudeng Zhabu as a separate banner; the emperor approved and separately invested him as jasak.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year (1752) Chenggun Zhabu requested that part of his following be granted to Chebudeng Zhabu as a separate banner; the emperor approved and separately invested him as jasak.

sentences.zh: 十九年，督兵剿撫烏梁海，獲准噶爾宰桑，賜貝子品級。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he supervised troops to suppress and pacify the Uriankhai and captured Dzungar zaisang; he was granted the rank of beile.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year (1754) he supervised troops to suppress and pacify the Uriankhai and captured Dzungar zaisang; he was granted the rank of beile.

sentences.zh: 二十年，師徵伊犁，車布登扎布將三百騎自察罕呼濟爾疾馳至集賽，擒宰桑齊巴漢，偵達瓦齊所在，奪舟渡伊犁河，逐達瓦齊，封多羅貝勒。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, when the army campaigned against Ili, Chebudeng Zhabu led three hundred cavalry from Chaghan Khujir in a forced march to Jisai, captured zaisang Qibahan, detected where Dawachi was, seized boats to cross the Ili River, and pursued Dawachi; he was enfeoffed duoluo beile.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year (1755), when the army campaigned against Ili, Chebudeng Zhabu led three hundred cavalry from Chaghan Khujir in a forced march to Jisai, captured zaisang Qibahan, detected where Dawachi was, seized boats to cross the Ili River, and pursued Dawachi; he was enfeoffed duoluo beile.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納謀以伊犁叛，車布登扎布首發其奸，密以告將軍班第。

translations.literal: Amursana plotted to rebel with Ili; Chebudeng Zhabu was first to expose his treachery and secretly informed General Bandi.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana plotted to rebel with Ili; Chebudeng Zhabu was first to expose his treachery and secretly informed General Bandi.

sentences.zh: 師還，命招降烏梁海部落，即以隸焉。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was ordered to induce the Uriankhai tribes to submit and they were placed under his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was ordered to induce the Uriankhai tribes to submit and they were placed under his jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，烏梁海酋郭勒卓輝譌言哈薩克汗阿布賚與阿睦爾撒納連合，上命率師討之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the Uriankhai chief Gelezhohui falsely reported that the Kazakh Khan Abulai had joined Amursana; the emperor ordered him to lead troops against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year (1756) the Uriankhai chief Gelezhohui falsely reported that the Kazakh Khan Abulai had joined Amursana; the emperor ordered him to lead troops against them.

sentences.zh: 有宰桑固爾班和卓者，攜千餘戶赴烏梁海謀偕遁，車布登扎布麾兵捕治，殲其眾。

translations.literal: A zaisang named Guerban Hezhuo brought more than a thousand households to the Uriankhai to plot escape together; Chebudeng Zhabu commanded troops to capture and punish them and annihilated their force.
translations.idiomatic: A zaisang named Guerban Hezhuo brought more than a thousand households to the Uriankhai to plot escape together; Chebudeng Zhabu commanded troops to capture and punish them and annihilated their force.

sentences.zh: 遂進兵哈薩克界，會尚書阿里袞自伊什勒諾爾轉戰至汗扎爾會，斬獲無算，封多羅郡王。

translations.literal: He then advanced into Kazakh territory; joining Minister Alihun, who had fought from Ishilenuoer to Khanzhar, they killed and captured beyond count; he was enfeoffed duoluo junwang.
translations.idiomatic: He then advanced into Kazakh territory; joining Minister Alihun, who had fought from Ishilenuoer to Khanzhar, they killed and captured beyond count; he was enfeoffed duoluo junwang.

sentences.zh: 成袞扎布討青袞咱卜，詔車布登扎布還烏里雅蘇台為佐。

translations.literal: When Chenggun Zhabu campaigned against Qinggun Zhabu, an edict ordered Chebudeng Zhabu back to Uliastai as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: When Chenggun Zhabu campaigned against Qinggun Zhabu, an edict ordered Chebudeng Zhabu back to Uliastai as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，代成袞扎佈署定邊左副將軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he acted as Left Deputy Border-pacifying General in Chenggun Zhabu's stead.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year (1757) he acted as Left Deputy Border-pacifying General in Chenggun Zhabu's stead.

sentences.zh: 尋命兆惠代成袞扎佈為定邊將軍，而以車布登扎佈為之副。

translations.literal: Soon Zhao Hui was ordered to replace Chenggun Zhabu as Border-pacifying General, with Chebudeng Zhabu as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Zhao Hui was ordered to replace Chenggun Zhabu as Border-pacifying General, with Chebudeng Zhabu as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 二十三年正月，授定邊右副將軍，從兆惠出巴里坤，遣兵赴哈什崆格斯搜逸寇。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-third year he was appointed Right Deputy Border-pacifying General, followed Zhao Hui out from Barkul, and dispatched troops to Hash Kongges to search out fugitive bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-third year (1758) he was appointed Right Deputy Border-pacifying General, followed Zhao Hui out from Barkul, and dispatched troops to Hash Kongges to search out fugitive bandits.

sentences.zh: 尋命赴博囉塔拉，捕布庫察罕、哈薩克錫喇等。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered to Boluotala to capture Buku Chahan, Kazakh Sira, and others.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to Boluotala to capture Buku Chahan, Kazakh Sira, and others.

sentences.zh: 哈薩克部人擒布庫察罕，哈薩克錫喇及宰桑鄂哲特等走和落霍斯，車布登扎布督兵逐之，哈薩克錫喇度不得脫，悉★據高岡拒戰。

translations.literal: Kazakh tribesmen captured Buku Chahan; Kazakh Sira and zaisang Ejete and others fled to Heluohuosi; Chebudeng Zhabu supervised troops in pursuit; Kazakh Sira, seeing he could not escape, all held the high ground to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Kazakh tribesmen captured Buku Chahan; Kazakh Sira and zaisang Ejete and others fled to Heluohuosi; Chebudeng Zhabu supervised troops in pursuit; Kazakh Sira, seeing he could not escape, all held the high ground to resist.

sentences.zh: 部將以兵寡，請待其走擊之，車布登扎布持不可，麾兵急進，擒鄂哲特，哈薩克錫喇僅以身免，詔以其父超勇號賜之。

translations.literal: A subordinate officer, because their force was few, asked to wait until the enemy fled and then strike; Chebudeng Zhabu would not agree and commanded the troops to advance urgently; Ejete was captured, Kazakh Sira barely escaped with his life; an edict granted him his father's name Chaoyong.
translations.idiomatic: A subordinate officer, because their force was few, asked to wait until the enemy fled and then strike; Chebudeng Zhabu would not agree and commanded the troops to advance urgently; Ejete was captured, Kazakh Sira barely escaped with his life; an edict granted him his father's name Chaoyong.

sentences.zh: 鄂哲特械至京師，言車布登扎布身先士卒，所向無前，上益嘉嘆，賜金黃帶。

translations.literal: Ejete was sent in bonds to the capital and said Chebudeng Zhabu led from the front and was irresistible; the emperor was still more pleased and granted the golden-yellow belt.
translations.idiomatic: Ejete was sent in bonds to the capital and said Chebudeng Zhabu led from the front and was irresistible; the emperor was still more pleased and granted the golden-yellow belt.

sentences.zh: 車布登扎布進次阿布勒噶爾，哈薩克縛布庫察罕以獻，因請赴阿克蘇與將軍兆惠會。

translations.literal: Chebudeng Zhabu advanced to Abulegaer; the Kazakhs bound Buku Chahan and presented him; he therefore requested to go to Aksu to meet General Zhao Hui.
translations.idiomatic: Chebudeng Zhabu advanced to Abulegaer; the Kazakhs bound Buku Chahan and presented him; he therefore requested to go to Aksu to meet General Zhao Hui.

sentences.zh: 上命還伊犁，進親王品級。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered him back to Ili and advanced him to princely rank.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered him back to Ili and advanced him to princely rank.

sentences.zh: 尋以在軍久，令歸游牧休息。

translations.literal: Soon, because he had been long on campaign, he was ordered to return to his pastures to rest.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, because he had been long on campaign, he was ordered to return to his pastures to rest.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，令佐將軍兆惠進葉爾羌討霍集占，旋復命還伊犁。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was ordered to assist General Zhao Hui in advancing on Yarkand to campaign against Huojizhan, and soon was again ordered back to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year (1759) he was ordered to assist General Zhao Hui in advancing on Yarkand to campaign against Huojizhan, and soon was again ordered back to Ili.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，使西藏。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was sent on mission to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year (1762) he was sent on mission to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，代成袞扎佈為定邊左副將軍，授盟長。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he replaced Chenggun Zhabu as Left Deputy Border-pacifying General and was appointed league chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year (1771) he replaced Chenggun Zhabu as Left Deputy Border-pacifying General and was appointed league chief.

sentences.zh: 以牟利被訐，罷左副將軍，擅請展牧界，削親王品級，命以郡王兼扎薩克世襲。

translations.literal: Because he was impeached for profiteering, he was dismissed as Left Deputy General; he had on his own authority requested extension of pasturage boundaries; his princely rank was reduced; he was ordered to inherit as junwang combined with jasak.
translations.idiomatic: Because he was impeached for profiteering, he was dismissed as Left Deputy General; he had on his own authority requested extension of pasturage boundaries; his princely rank was reduced; he was ordered to inherit as junwang combined with jasak.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year (1782) he died.

sentences.zh: 子三丕勒多爾濟，襲。

translations.literal: His son Sanbele Dorji inherited.
translations.idiomatic: His son Sanbele Dorji inherited.

sentences.zh: 論曰：世傳鍾琪長身赬面，隆準而駢脅。

translations.literal: The commentary says: It is handed down that Zhongqi was tall in stature, ruddy-faced, with a high nose and joined ribs.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: It is handed down that Zhongqi was tall in stature, ruddy-faced, with a high nose and joined ribs.

sentences.zh: 臨陣挾二銅鎚，重百餘斤，指麾嚴肅不可犯。

translations.literal: In battle he carried two bronze maces weighing more than a hundred jin; his command was stern and not to be violated.
translations.idiomatic: In battle he carried two bronze maces weighing more than a hundred jin; his command was stern and not to be violated.

sentences.zh: 軍西陲久，番部皆讋其名。

translations.literal: Long on the western frontier, the frontier tribes all feared his name.
translations.idiomatic: Long on the western frontier, the frontier tribes all feared his name.

sentences.zh: 其受莎羅奔降也，傅恆升幄坐，鍾琪戎服佩刀侍。

translations.literal: When he received Salopan's surrender, Fu Heng ascended the dais and sat; Zhongqi in military dress with sword at his side attended.
translations.idiomatic: When he received Salopan's surrender, Fu Heng ascended the dais and sat; Zhongqi in military dress with sword at his side attended.

sentences.zh: 莎羅奔出語人曰：「我曹仰岳公如天人，乃傅公儼然踞其上，天朝大人誠不可測也！」

translations.literal: Salopan went out and said to people: "We looked up to Duke Yue as to a being from heaven — yet Duke Fu sits loftily above him; the great ministers of the Celestial Dynasty are truly beyond reckoning!"
translations.idiomatic: Salopan went out and said to people: "We looked up to Duke Yue as to a being from heaven — yet Duke Fu sits loftily above him; the great ministers of the Celestial Dynasty are truly beyond reckoning!"

sentences.zh: 策棱白晰微髭，善用兵，所部多奇士。

translations.literal: Celeng was fair-skinned with a light beard, skilled in the use of troops; his following had many extraordinary men.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng was fair-skinned with a light beard, skilled in the use of troops; his following had many extraordinary men.

sentences.zh: 有脫克渾者，日行千里，登高張兩手，若雕鼓翼，诇敵，敵不之察。

translations.literal: There was one named Tuokenhun who could travel a thousand li in a day; climbing high he spread both hands like an eagle beating its wings to spy on the enemy, and the enemy did not detect him.
translations.idiomatic: There was one named Tuokenhun who could travel a thousand li in a day; climbing high he spread both hands like an eagle beating its wings to spy on the enemy, and the enemy did not detect him.

sentences.zh: 事定，策棱欲官之，辭，賚以千金，酌酒勞之。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, Celeng wished to give him office; he declined; Celeng rewarded him with a thousand taels of gold and poured wine to toast him.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled, Celeng wished to give him office; he declined; Celeng rewarded him with a thousand taels of gold and poured wine to toast him.

sentences.zh: 脫克渾請出侍姬舞，起而歌，慷慨，策棱大悅，即以姬及所乘馬賜之。

translations.literal: Tuokenhun asked that a serving concubine dance; rising he sang, boldly and generously; Celeng was greatly pleased and bestowed on him the concubine and the horse he rode.
translations.idiomatic: Tuokenhun asked that a serving concubine dance; rising he sang, boldly and generously; Celeng was greatly pleased and bestowed on him the concubine and the horse he rode.

sentences.zh: 載籍言名將，往往舉其狀貌及其軼事，使讀者慕焉。

translations.literal: Historical records speaking of famous generals often cite their appearance and their anecdotes, so that readers may admire them.
translations.idiomatic: Historical records speaking of famous generals often cite their appearance and their anecdotes, so that readers may admire them.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪忠而毅，策棱忠而勇，班諸衛、霍、郭、李之倫，毋謂古今人不相及也。

translations.literal: Zhongqi was loyal and resolute, Celeng loyal and brave; ranked with Wei, Huo, Guo, and Li, one need not say that men of ancient and modern times cannot be compared.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi was loyal and resolute, Celeng loyal and brave; ranked with Wei, Huo, Guo, and Li, one need not say that men of ancient and modern times cannot be compared.
